Discover more about our company-wide benefits and life at GSK on our webpage Life at GSK | GSK

Find out more about GSK and R&D: Our approach to R&D

Associate Director - Real World Biostatistics

As an Associate Director - Real World Biostatistics,you will lead the design and delivery of biostatistical methods and analyses for real-world data to support access and patient impact in the United States. The role advises on and applies advanced biostatistical methods and AI tools to real world data (RWD) to generate real world evidence (RWE) for informing trial design, regulatory submissions, reimbursement and safety signals. You will collaborate closely with diverse teams across medical affairs, epidemiology, health economics, market access, and external partners. We value candidates who are curious, collaborative, and communicate clearly. This role offers meaningful impact, strong career growth, and a chance to align with GSK’s mission of uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

This role is fully remote in the US or the UK.

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  • Lead statistical design and analysis for real-world evidence studies using large healthcare data sets.
  • Translate stakeholder questions into study protocols and statistical analysis plans that address bias and study limitations.
  • Manage study execution, including timelines, budgets, quality control, and vendor coordination.
  • Develop and review analytic code ensuring reproducibility and quality using programming tools such as R or SAS.
  • Communicate results clearly to internal teams and external audiences, supporting publications and payer dossiers.
  • Mentor junior biostatisticians and contribute to best practices across evidence generation teams.

Basic Qualifications:

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:


  • Master’s degree or PhD in biostatistics, epidemiology, statistics, data science, or related quantitative field.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience applying biostatistics to real-world data, pharmacoepidemiology, or health outcomes research.

Preferred Qualifications:

Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply:


  • PhD in biostatistics, epidemiology, or related discipline.
  • Practical experience with programming languages such as R and/or SAS and reproducible analysis workflows.
  • Experience working with large US real-world data sources such as insurance claims, electronic health records, or registries.
  • Prior experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry supporting access, reimbursement, or regulatory decisions.
  • A track record of peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, or contributions to methodological guidelines.
  • Familiarity with advanced causal inference methods, propensity score techniques, or longitudinal modeling.
  • Strong knowledge of observational study design, causal inference methods, and methods to address bias.
  • Experience mentoring and developing junior biostatisticians or early career scientists.
  • Experience working in matrix environments with cross-functional teams and managing vendors.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to clearly explain technical results to non-technical audiences.


Skills

Cross-Functional Leadership, Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, Evidence Based Decision Making, Flexible Mindset, High Impact Communication, Launch Excellence, Patient JourneyThe US annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges from $141,750 to $236,250. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Available benefits include health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, paid holidays, vacation, and paid caregiver/parental and medical leave. If salary ranges are not displayed in the job posting for a specific country, the relevant compensation will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees.

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

*5 years Recruiting/Talent Acquisition for both exempt and non-exempt roles at least 3 recruiting in pharmacy spaces (retail, specialty, hospital)

raw.excerpt: About the RoleAs the Data Strategy and Operations Manager at Abnormal AI, you will own our go-to-market data quality strategy and serve as the steward of data across Salesforce and the systems around it.
raw.description:
About the Role

As the Data Strategy and Operations Manager at Abnormal AI, you will own our go-to-market data quality strategy and serve as the steward of data across Salesforce and the systems around it. You will design the processes, controls, and intelligent workflows that keep data accurate, enriched, and trusted at scale, so Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance can give executive leadership reliable metrics. You will decide where AI agents and automation take over repetitive data work and where human judgment still matters, and partner with cross-functional teams to evaluate system changes that affect our data programs.

Who you are

  • Data obsessed and just as obsessed with removing manual work, with a habit of automating any process that relies on fixing records by hand
  • Curious about AI and a daily user, with experience shipping workflows with LLMs, agents, or AI-assisted tooling, and able to tell a useful application from a demo
  • Eager to build and shape a program rather than only maintain one, and able to create systems that hold up at global scale
  • Highly analytical, able to see the big picture and spot trends and gaps, then zoom in with practical, specific recommendations
  • Steady when juggling multiple priorities in a constantly changing environment
  • A good teammate, dedicated to the mission, who likes to have fun along the way

What you will do

  • Set the data governance strategy, standards, ownership model, and source-of-truth hierarchy for GTM data across Salesforce and connected systems
  • Establish policies, access controls, and field-level definitions, including record creation and deprecation rules, and monitor adherence
  • Ensure compliance and security of our data, and flag risks to IT, security, and leadership
  • Replace high-volume manual tasks (deduplication, enrichment, account matching, hierarchy mapping, routing, anomaly review) with automated and AI-assisted workflows
  • Design and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered workflows that classify, enrich, validate, and remediate data, with guardrails, human review points, and accuracy measurement
  • Build automated data quality monitoring that detects issues early, alerts the right owner, and fixes them without human intervention where appropriate
  • Evaluate and select AI, enrichment, and automation tooling, run pilots, and measure impact through time saved, accuracy gains, and coverage
  • Own the enrichment strategy and keep account firmographics accurate: hierarchies, employee count, location, industry, and Fortune ranking
  • Act as the subject matter expert for Business Ops, Marketing Ops, Customer Success, and Finance, run a defined feedback intake process, and support consistent reporting and dashboards
  • Manage a portfolio of data quality and automation projects with clear priorities, owners, and outcomes

Must Haves

  • 5+ years in Sales Operations, Data Operations, or a similar analytical or systems role
  • Hands-on experience building automation with AI or LLM tools (agents, prompt-driven workflows, AI-assisted enrichment), with shipped examples you can easily share
  • Strong understanding of data lifecycle management, data modeling, master data management, and requirements gathering
  • Demonstrated understanding of Salesforce automation, including Flow and validation rules, and experience working closely with admins
  • Experience implementing and managing data and enrichment tools, including AI-native tools such as Clay, Kernel, Starbridge, and Onfire
  • Proficiency in Excel
  • Track record of leading data management projects from idea to result
  • Sound judgment about where AI is reliable and where it needs controls for privacy, security, and accuracy
  • Detail oriented, self-motivated, proactive, and quick to learn new tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical and AI concepts to non-technical partners
  • Preferred: experience with workflow automation or integration platforms (such as Workato or Zapier), modern data stack tools (such as Snowflake or dbt), SQL, and a high-growth SaaS or security company

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$107,100—$154,000 USD

A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Description

Location: Fully Remote (United States)

Compensation: $60–78/hour + competitive bonus structure, administration time pay, and paid onboarding

Commitment: Part-time (1099); 15 patient-facing hours/week minimum (~18–20 total weekly hours including administrative time and required clinical meetings)

About the Role

Visana Health is a virtual women’s clinic providing compassionate, evidence-based care for complex and historically overlooked conditions, including endometriosis, fibroids, chronic pelvic pain, and heavy menstrual bleeding. We are seeking mission-driven Nurse Practitioners (NP, FNP, or CNM) to deliver high-touch virtual care and collaborate with an expert clinical team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide comprehensive, compassionate virtual care visits using evidence-based care and treatment plans.
  • Deliver timely follow-up via messaging, phone calls, and lab/test result reviews.
  • Complete accurate clinical documentation and billing within 24 hours of each encounter.
  • Attend weekly clinical meetings to discuss complex cases and share clinical insights.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 4+ years of NP experience in women’s health (via clinical practice, specialty certification, or both).
  • Licensure: Active, unencumbered NP/CNM licenses and prescriptive authority with independent practice eligibility where applicable.
  • Multistate Coverage: Active licenses in at least 3 states, including:
  • Group A (at least 1): CA, NY, IN, GA, OH, TN, MN, AZ, or PA.
  • Group B (at least 1): VA, MO, KY, CO, FL, TX, MS, AL, NC, AR, CT, or NJ.
  • Certification: Board-certified in Family Practice, Adult Health, Women’s Health, or Nurse-Midwifery; active DEA registration.
  • Availability: Consistent Friday coverage and minimum 15 direct patient hours/week (shifts available between 6:30 AM – 10:00 PM local time).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Dual background in primary care and women’s health.
  • Prior experience with Athenahealth EMR and telehealth platforms.
  • Multilingual skills.

What We Offer

  • Malpractice Insurance: Full comprehensive coverage provided.
  • Paid Admin Time: We pay for admin time when your schedules are full, so you don't have to manage that competing priority.
  • Supportive Environment: Access to collaborating physicians, peer case conferences, mentoring, and core provider support.

Responsabilidades

  • Desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones backend utilizando Java y Spring Boot.

  • Diseñar, implementar y evolucionar microservicios y APIs REST.

  • Participar en la integración con plataformas financieras y sistemas corporativos.

  • Proporcionar soporte y resolver incidencias en entornos de producción.

  • Participar en despliegues y procesos de integración y entrega continua (CI/CD).

  • Colaborar con equipos técnicos multidisciplinares bajo metodologías Agile/Scrum.

  • Garantizar la calidad, el rendimiento, la estabilidad y el correcto funcionamiento de las aplicaciones.

Requisitos

  • Al menos 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software.

  • Más de 4 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend con Java.

  • Experiencia sólida con Spring Boot y Spring Framework.

  • Experiencia en diseño e implementación de arquitecturas de microservicios.

  • Experiencia en diseño e integración de APIs REST.

  • Conocimientos de bases de datos relacionales (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server o similares).

  • Experiencia en entornos CI/CD y herramientas como Jenkins, GitHub Actions o equivalentes.

  • Experiencia trabajando bajo metodologías Agile/Scrum.

  • Experiencia demostrable en proyectos del sector bancario, medios de pago, fintech o seguros (requisito imprescindible).

  • Experiencia en aplicaciones críticas de negocio y soporte a producción.

  • Nivel medio de inglés (B2).

Valorable

  • Kafka.

  • Arquitectura Hexagonal.

  • AWS, AKS u OpenShift (OCP).

  • OpenAPI / Swagger.

  • Testing automatizado con JUnit, Mockito y Cucumber.

Condiciones

  • Conocimiento clave: Java.

  • Tarifa máxima: 28.000 SBA

  • Ubicación: Madrid, España.

  • Modalidad de trabajo: Remoto.

Compañía

Formar parte de THEWHITEAM es colaborar con una empresa formada por profesionales con una dilatada experiencia en consultoría tecnológica.

Creemos firmemente que las empresas y clientes marcan el camino a seguir en el sector, pero éste lo construyen las personas. Consideramos de vital importancia que nuestra organización se fundamente en nuestro mejor activo y marca de valor añadido que es nuestro equipo humano.

Beneficios

raw.excerpt: OverviewWe are seeking a Manager, Product Operations & Delivery to drive the execution of our product roadmap across ViaPath’s enterprise Offender Management System (OMS) platform.
raw.description:
Overview

We are seeking a Manager, Product Operations & Delivery to drive the execution of our product roadmap across ViaPath’s enterprise Offender Management System (OMS) platform. This role serves as the operational backbone of the product organization—ensuring that strategy is translated into clear, actionable, and high-quality delivery work.

You will lead the Product Analyst function and oversee the systems, processes, and standards that enable effective backlog management, requirements quality, and cross-functional alignment. This is a highly collaborative role that partners closely with Product, UX, Engineering, QA, Implementation, and Support teams to ensure product initiatives are well-defined, development-ready, and successfully delivered.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product operations, delivery execution, and team leadership, and who enjoys bringing structure and clarity to complex software environments.

This is a remote based position based anywhere in the contiguous US. Must be located near an airport to meet the travel requirement for the position.

Responsibilities

Product Delivery & Backlog Management

  • Translate approved product roadmap initiatives into structured, trackable delivery work (epics, features, user stories) within Jira
  • Maintain a well-organized, transparent backlog aligned to roadmap themes and priorities
  • Ensure end-to-end traceability between roadmap initiatives and delivery artifacts in Jira and Confluence

Requirements Quality & Readiness

  • Establish and enforce standards for high-quality requirements, including clarity, completeness, testability, and dependency management
  • Lead backlog refinement sessions to ensure all work meets “ready for development” criteria
  • Partner with UX, Engineering, and QA to clarify functional intent and resolve gaps early in the delivery lifecycle

Team Leadership & Enablement

  • Manage and mentor a team of Product Analysts responsible for functional design, user stories, and documentation
  • Provide coaching, workload planning, and performance management to ensure high-quality output and team growth
  • Foster consistency in documentation practices, tooling usage, and delivery standards
  • Feedback Synthesis & Continuous Improvement
  • Aggregate and analyze feedback from Support, Implementation, and other customer-facing teams
  • Identify trends, root causes, and opportunities, translating insights into actionable backlog items
  • Recommend priorities, scope tradeoffs, and improvements to product leadership based on operational data

Release Coordination & Communication

  • Coordinate release readiness activities, ensuring scope completion and stakeholder alignment
  • Support release validation and ensure delivered functionality meets defined acceptance criteria
  • Draft and publish clear, accurate release notes and supporting product communications
  • Develop internal enablement materials such as feature summaries and user guidance

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain organized, accessible documentation in Confluence, including requirements, workflows, and decision logs
  • Track and escalate risks, gaps, and cross-team dependencies to maintain delivery momentum
  • Continuously improve processes related to backlog management, documentation, feedback intake, and release communication

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Business Analysis, Product Operations, Software Delivery, Information Systems, or related fields
  • 8+ years of experience in product analysis, functional analysis, business analysis, or software delivery support within enterprise software environments with a minimum of 2 years of experience directly managing analysts or leading a requirements-focused function, including coaching, performance management, and workload planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business needs into structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation suitable for software delivery.
  • Strong experience managing backlogs and work tracking in tools such as Jira and maintaining structured documentation in Confluence (or comparable platforms).
  • Proven ability to synthesize feedback from Support, Implementation, and other customer-facing teams and convert it into actionable product work with clear recommendations.
  • Excellent writing, documentation, and organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Experience collaborating closely with UX, Engineering, and QA to ensure functional intent is understood, testable, and delivered as expected.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, drive clarity across teams, maintain consistent follow-through, and operate confidently in a decision-support role to product leadership.
  • Experience with corrections or justice-related software workflows preferred but not required.
  • Must be able and willing to travel up to 10% of the time.

Additional Information

ViaPath is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals and to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions are based on individual merit, qualifications, performance, and business needs. In accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, ViaPath does not discriminate or permit harassment against any employee or applicant based on any characteristic protected by law. ViaPath’s commitment applies to the fullest extent required by federal, state, and local laws applicable to its contracts and operations.

Benefits Overview

ViaPath is committed to supporting the health, well-being, and security of our employees. Eligible full-time employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance – Multiple plan options designed to support a variety of coverage needs.
  • Health Saving Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) – Employer provided contribution to the HSA for eligible medical plans. Healthcare and dependent care spending accounts available.
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO) – Including vacation and sick time
  • Company Holidays
  • Retirement Plan (401(k)) – Traditional and Roth 401(k) options available including employer matching contributions.
  • Life & Disability Insurance – Company-paid basic life insurance and short-term disability; additional voluntary coverage available.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Free, confidential support for personal, financial, and family matters.
  • Additional Well-Being Resources – Includes access to Care.com, Calm, Active&Fit, Telavet, LegalShield, and other lifestyle resources and discounted services.

Eligibility for certain benefits may depend on employee status, work location, and applicable plan documents. Benefits and terms are subject to change. The information above provides a brief summary of our benefit programs. Actual coverage details are governed by the official plan documents, which control in the event of conflict. ViaPath reserves the right to modify or terminate any benefit program at any time.

info:

3C Deutschland ist ein führender Technologiepartner im digitalen Schadenmanagement für Versicherungen in der DACH-Region. Unsere Plattform steuert den kompletten Schadenprozess, von der Meldung über die Prüfung bis zur finalen Regulierung, und schafft dabei Transparenz, Effizienz und Prozesssicherheit.

Unter dem Dach des Berliner Private-Equity-Fonds FLEX Capital befinden wir uns aktuell in einer dynamischen Wachstums- und Internationalisierungsphase.

Als Product Owner bildest du die Schnittstelle zwischen Produktmanagement und Softwareentwicklung. Während das Produktmanagement Markt- und Kundenanforderungen verantwortet, liegt dein Schwerpunkt auf der fachlichen Ausgestaltung und der Umsetzung gemeinsam mit dem Entwicklungsteam. JOB TITLE: Digital Communications Intern (Spring 2027)
POSITION CLASSIFICATION: Internship (Part-Time, Temporary)
SALARY BAND: Unpaid, Internship subsidy available (up to $500/year)

REPORTS TO:

Online Communications Manager

LOCATION: Virtual (United States-based)

About American Rivers

American Rivers is championing a national effort to protect and restore all rivers, from remote mountain streams to urban waterways. Healthy rivers provide people and nature with clean, abundant water and natural habitat. For 50 years, American Rivers staff, supporters, and partners have shared a common belief:

Life Depends on Rivers℠.

The beauty of rivers is that they connect all people and communities – including within our organization. The life experiences, knowledge, innovation, and talent that different people bring to our work provides perspectives, experiences, and competencies which are critical to our effectiveness in protecting wild rivers, restoring damaged rivers, and conserving clean water for people and nature.

Job Summary

The Digital Communications Intern will support the American Rivers Digital Team’s day-to-day communications initiatives, with a primary focus on social media and digital engagement. This internship offers hands-on experience creating content for a national environmental nonprofit, including assisting with graphics, video editing, blogs, and social media engagement across American Rivers’ digital platforms. The role is ideal for a student interested in nonprofit communications, digital storytelling, and environmental advocacy who is eager to develop professional skills in content creation, audience engagement, and multimedia communications.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Support the creation of graphics, short-form videos, and other engagement-focused digital content.
  • Assist with video editing for social media campaigns, storytelling initiatives, and organizational communications.
  • Help draft and edit blogs, captions, and other digital communications materials.
  • Monitor social media channels for comments, messages, and engagement opportunities, escalating questions or concerns as needed.
  • Support the Digital Team with analytics tracking.
  • Attend and participate in greater marketing and communications team meetings.
  • Support additional communications and digital engagement projects as assigned.
  • Assist with email and website content quality assurance, including proofreading copy and checking links, formatting, and functionality
  • Provide support around digital asset management and graphics/videos/photo organization

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current college student pursuing a degree, preferably in communications, marketing, digital media, earth science, environmental science/studies, public relations, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated interest in digital communications, social media, and environmental advocacy.
  • Experience with video editing software and creating short-form digital content for social media platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms and digital tools such as Zoom, Slack, Sprout, WordPress, Canva, and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced setting.

Candidates who are unsure if they meet all minimum qualifications or who have transferrable skills and experience beyond the conservation sector are encouraged to apply.

Location

Remote (United States-based).

Compensation

This unpaid internship includes a modest subsidy (up to $500/year). The role is part-time (approximately 10-15 hours per week) and runs approx. from January 11, 2027 – May 7, 2027
with an opportunity to start earlier and end later if applicable.

Community and Opportunity

At American Rivers, our core values drive everything we do – we Lead with Collaboration and Trust, Infuse Equity and Justice, Deliver Results, and Ensure Staff and Volunteers Thrive. We are committed to fostering a workplace where interns feel valued, supported, and empowered to make a difference.

Interns will gain:

  • Mentorship from experienced communications professionals.
  • Networking opportunities with communications staff, the digital team, and various Communities of Practice.
  • Opportunities to showcase their work through published blogs, social media posts, all staff ‘brown bag’ presentations, and other deliverables.

American Rivers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities upon request. To request this document in an alternate format or to request reasonable accommodation, please contact the Human Resources department at 202-243-7040 or . Please note that one week’s advance notice is preferred.

Applicant must be legally allowed to work as an employee in the United States. American Rivers is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Candidates of all personal and professional backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Salary: unpaid

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Position Overview

The Finance Manager is responsible for overseeing Kalpa's day-to-day accounting operations while ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and efficiency of financial processes across our global organization. This role serves as the operational leader of the finance function, managing the monthly financial cycle, supporting payroll and billing operations, maintaining compliance, and providing financial reporting and analysis to leadership.

Working closely with the executive team, the Finance Manager ensures financial information is timely, accurate, and actionable while continuously improving accounting processes, internal controls, and operational efficiency. This position requires strong accounting expertise, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to lead financial operations in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Core Responsibilities

1. Financial Operations & Accounting Management

  • Oversee daily accounting operations, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll processing, and general ledger activities.

  • Review and approve client billing, vendor payments, journal entries, and reconciliations for accuracy and completeness.

  • Ensure month-end and year-end close activities are completed accurately and on schedule.

  • Maintain the integrity of financial records across multiple entities and currencies.

  • Monitor accounting transactions to ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards.

2. Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare monthly financial statements and supporting schedules for leadership review.

  • Analyze financial results, identify trends, and investigate variances.

  • Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.

  • Develop recurring financial reports and dashboards to support operational decision-making.

  • Provide recommendations to improve financial performance and operational efficiency.

3. Payroll, Compensation & Compliance

  • Oversee payroll processing and ensure accurate recording of payroll-related journal entries.

  • Review variable compensation calculations, including commissions, bonuses, and referral incentives.

  • Ensure compliance with payroll regulations, tax remittances, GST/HST filings, and other statutory requirements.

  • Support audit requests and maintain complete financial documentation.

4. Banking, Reconciliations & Cash Management

  • Review monthly bank and credit card reconciliations.

  • Monitor cash flow and assist with short-term cash planning.

  • Ensure timely processing of vendor payments and customer collections.

  • Support banking relationships and maintain accurate cash reporting.

5. Financial Controls & Process Improvement

  • Strengthen accounting procedures and internal controls to improve accuracy and reduce risk.

  • Identify opportunities to automate financial processes and improve operational efficiency.

  • Document and standardize accounting workflows and best practices.

  • Support ERP optimization and financial system enhancements.

6. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, and support to members of the finance team.

  • Review work completed by junior accounting staff and provide constructive feedback.

  • Collaborate with Delivery Leaders, Operations, HR, Sales, and executive leadership to resolve financial issues and improve processes.

  • Foster accountability, continuous learning, and high standards of financial excellence across the team.


Requirements

The Finance Manager ensures the financial engine of Kalpa operates smoothly and accurately. By overseeing accounting operations, strengthening financial controls, and providing reliable financial reporting, this role enables informed business decisions and supports sustainable growth. Their leadership helps ensure the finance team delivers consistent, timely, and high-quality financial information while continuously improving the efficiency of internal processes.

Candidate Profile & Mindset

  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, payroll accounting, reconciliations, and month-end close processes.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

  • Effective communicator who can explain financial information to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working independently within a fully remote, global environment.

  • Process-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset.

  • Collaborative leader who enjoys mentoring others and building efficient financial operations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • CPA designation

  • 5–7 years of progressive accounting or finance experience.

  • Experience preparing financial statements, managing month-end close, and overseeing payroll and reconciliations.

  • Experience with ERP systems and cloud-based accounting software.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

  • Previous experience in consulting, professional services, technology, or ERP organizations is considered an asset.

  • Prior experience leading or mentoring accounting staff is preferred.


Benefits

The Finance Manager plays a vital role in ensuring Kalpa's financial operations remain accurate, efficient, and scalable. By combining strong technical accounting expertise with operational leadership and continuous process improvement, this role supports the organization's growth while providing the financial foundation needed for sound business decisions. As a trusted partner across the organization, the Finance Manager helps strengthen financial discipline, improve operational performance, and prepare the business for future expansion.

NationSwell is a one-of-a-kind executive membership community and advisory firm for mission-driven leaders and their organizations. Our Institutional Membership (IM) is an invitation-only program for leading companies, philanthropies, and investment firms. It is designed to help leaders advance their work in social impact, sustainability, philanthropy, and purpose-driven culture. The NationSwell Studio works with leaders in the impact space to create transformative social impact strategies, provide in-depth research and insights, engage key audiences, and more.

The Opportunity:

NationSwell is seeking a part-time Revenue Operations & Systems Lead to drive the development and implementation of scalable systems, processes, and reporting that power our membership business.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, technically proficient, detail-oriented, and comfortable translating business needs into practical systems solutions. This is a hands-on builder role, focused on end-to-end building and maintenance of the operational infrastructure that enables leadership to make informed decisions and teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality member experience.

Position Details: This is a remote, part-time, hourly role that must be performed in the United States, at approximately 16-24 hours per week on a flexible schedule. Compensation for the role is $45 to $55 per hour, based on experience and skills. Applications will be accepted through November 30, 2026.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Dedicated Member Success Support: Initially serve as the dedicated systems and operations lead for Member Success, streamlining administrative, project management, and reporting operations to enhance the team’s capacity for member engagement, relationship management, and revenue-generating activities.
  • Member Lifecycle & Experience Tracking: Build and maintain the systems and workflows that track the member journey from onboarding and activation through engagement, renewal, and expansion, including deliverables, engagement activities, event invitations and registrations, fulfillment of membership commitments, and other key milestones, so the team has one clear view of each member.
  • Systems Integration & Cross-Functional Support: Own data flow and integrity across shared systems, including sync logic, field mapping, and account ownership hygiene, while working with Member Success, Events, Growth, Insights, Operations, and Studio to ensure every team works from a reliable source of truth.
  • Process Development and Improvement: Own the documentation and standardization of Member Success processes, including account management workflows, cross-functional handoffs, member touchpoints, and recurring activities, while identifying administrative inefficiencies and implementing process improvements.
  • AI, Automation, & Systems Implementation: Build, test, and maintain practical solutions to operational challenges, including AI and automation tools like Claude and Outreach AI. Gather input from users, then own the build, testing, iteration, deployment, and documentation, from problem identification through adoption, so tools stay reliable and widely used.
  • Member Health & Engagement Reporting: Build member-health reports, dashboards, tracking tools, and triggers that consolidate connections, engagement, event attendance, participation, relationship information, touchpoints, and utilization to surface indicators of expansion opportunity, membership value, or renewal risk.
  • Renewal & Retention Analytics: Track and analyze renewal rates, retention trends, churn, and expansion across membership tiers and customer segments, and prepare supporting analyses for membership planning, operational improvements, and leadership decision-making as needed.

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Customer Success Operations, Business Operations, Sales Operations, or a related role, with a track record of building and owning systems, ideally within a membership, community, or event-based organization.

  • Excellent analytical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to translate operational needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple projects, prioritize deliverables, and work effectively in a part-time capacity.
  • Familiarity with customer success metrics, including engagement, retention, renewal rates, churn, expansion, and customer health scoring.

This part-time role is not eligible for company-sponsored health or retirement benefits. Paid sick leave is provided as required by applicable state and local law.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Coding Education Specialist is responsible for assisting with design, development, and delivery of all Coding Quality and Education components for all areas supported by Professional Billing. This individual is a member of a cross functional team, which includes practice leadership, business owners, IT, the professional billing office, revenue cycle teams and others as needed. This individual will work closely with these various groups to develop, implement and manage medical record review, communication, and education strategies that are needed to achieve desired results. As a highly strategic department representative, this individual consistently demonstrates solid project management skills and behaviors, in addition to continually striving to meet and exceed customer expectations.

Boston Medical Center (BMC) is more than a hospital. It´s a network of support and care that touches the lives of hundreds of thousands of people in need each year. It is the largest and busiest provider of trauma and emergency services in New England. Emphasizing community-based care, BMC is committed to providing consistently excellent and accessible health services to all—and is the largest safety-net hospital in New England. The hospital is also the primary teaching affiliate of the nationally ranked Boston University School of Medicine (BUSM) and a founding partner of Boston HealthNet – an integrated health care delivery systems that includes many community health centers. Join BMC today and help us achieve our Vision 2030 which is a long-term goal to make Boston the healthiest urban population in the world.

Position: Coding Education Specialist

Department: BUMG Corporate PBO General

Schedule: Full Time

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

  • Assist with development of strategic coding communication and education plans which outline the target audience, training needs, training methods and implementation.

  • Assist with the development of coding content-specific, competency-based, and operational-based communication and educational deliverables in conjunction with specific business unit resources and technical experts.

  • Creates presentations, develops learning materials, handbooks, and other training materials.

  • Lead training sessions on current billing and coding information in the medical field.

  • Provide mentoring and education to physicians and provide feedback to 3rd party vendor on findings to improve their current performance.

  • Communicates and advises the Physician Group and Revenue Cycle staff on coding and documentation principles.

  • Manage the delivery of communication and coding training to various groups, including leadership teams and end-users. Delivery methods may include instructor-led, train the trainer, virtual classroom, web-cast, or web based methodologies.

  • Manage the maintenance of coding training materials.

  • Review and respond to coding questions.

  • Perform random chart audits.

  • Maintains confidentiality with all company and regulated information.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Must adhere to all of BMC’s RESPECT behavioral standards.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of formal education and experience.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

  • Must be a Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Specialist – Physician(CCS-P) through AHIMA(American Information Management Association) or AAPC’s (American Academy of Professional Coders) Certified Professional Coder(CPC®) credential or Certified Professional Coder-Hospital (CPC-H®)

EXPERIENCE:

  • Three years of experience in E/M and/or surgical coding plus reimbursement activities is a required.

  • In addition, a clinical background and previous chart abstraction experience is preferred.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Excellent written, verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Time management and organizational skills. Self-directed.

  • Ability to make quality, independent decisions.

  • Analytical and strong problem solving skills.

  • Ability to work effectively and efficiently under tight deadlines, high volumes and multiple interruptions.

  • Ability to maintain the strictest levels of confidentiality.

  • Ability to listen to others.

  • Competency in the use of a variety of computer hardware and software systems.

  • Excellent command of the ICD-10, HCPCS, and CPT coding conventions, E&M coding.

  • Work also requires concepts of human anatomy, physiology and pathology.

Compensation Range:

$62,500.00- $91,000.00

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. raw.description:
The Enterprise Account Executive will generate new business sales revenue in the West region. This will be achieved through account planning, territory planning, working with Nexthink partners, business development techniques, and field-based sales activities. The ideal candidate will have:

Why this role matters

The next evolution of IT is not just about uptime. It is about experience, productivity, automation, and measurable business value.

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Nexthink, you will help CIOs, Digital Workplace leaders, End User Computing teams, Service Desk leaders, and IT Operations executives answer questions like:

  • How do we find and fix technology issues before employees report them?
  • How do we reduce ticket volume and improve service quality at scale?
  • How do we measure whether employees are actually adopting new tools, including AI?
  • How do we turn IT from a cost center into a driver of productivity and employee experience?
  • How do we make digital work feel seamless?

You help customers rethink the operating model of enterprise IT.

What you will do

You will own new business growth across your assigned territory by building a strategic territory plan, creating executive-level demand, and driving complex enterprise sales cycles from initial engagement through close.

  • Build, manage, and execute a regional sales strategy for the North Central territory.
  • Prospect aggressively into enterprise accounts and develop qualified pipeline.
  • Identify business pains tied to employee productivity, IT support, application adoption, digital transformation, and AI readiness.
  • Engage multiple stakeholders across IT, Digital Workplace, End User Computing, Service Management, Infrastructure, Security, Procurement, and executive leadership.
  • Evangelize Nexthink’s value proposition and educate customers on the rapidly evolving DEX category.
  • Partner with Nexthink’s business development, marketing, channel, solution consulting, and professional services teams to create and advance opportunities.
  • Lead discovery, business case development, executive presentations, proof-of-concept alignment, negotiation, and close.
  • Manage customer expectations throughout evaluations and proof-of-concept cycles.
  • Sell the full Nexthink solution, including software, services, and support, to ensure long-term customer success.
  • Build trusted relationships that create expansion opportunities and durable customer value.
  • Consistently exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual bookings targets.

What makes you a strong fit

You are a high-performing enterprise seller who knows how to create a market, not just respond to one. You are energized by new categories, complex problems, and executive conversations where you can connect technology to measurable business outcomes.

  • 7+ years of enterprise technology sales experience in a fast-paced, competitive B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
  • A proven record of quota overachievement, such as President’s Club, top rep performance, or consistent attainment above plan.
  • Experience selling complex solutions to large enterprise IT organizations.
  • Ability to evangelize emerging categories and educate buyers on new ways of solving business problems.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to sell across technical, operational, and business stakeholders.
  • Discipline in territory planning, account strategy, pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, and deal execution.
  • Comfort managing proof-of-concept processes and aligning technical validation to business value.
  • A consultative sales approach with strong discovery, storytelling, and value-selling skills.
  • High ownership, urgency, resilience, and intellectual curiosity.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Sold disruptive or category-creating technology in an early-stage, high-growth, or market-expansion environment.
  • A track record of opening new logos and building territory from the ground up.
  • The ability to simplify complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.
  • A strong partner ecosystem mindset and experience working with channel, alliance, or services partners.
  • The confidence to challenge customer assumptions while building trust.

The base salary for this role is $150,000-180,000 gross per year, with a total on-target earnings (OTE) range of $300,000-360,000 with additional opportunity to earn commissions above this range.

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1200 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages

Total Rewards @ Nexthink

At Nexthink, we offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans. Your total rewards compensation package includes base salary and may also include a commission or performance bonus plan. We provide our US employees with 100% covered company benefits that consist of health, dental, vision as well as access to life insurance, long-term disability, and accidental death/personal loss coverage.

In addition, we offer:

  • 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 15 days of holidays we offer), 11 company-paid holidays, and 3 extra days for volunteering.
  • 🏡 Hybrid work model that balances office and remote work, with structured onboarding to foster connections and team integration.
  • 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills.
  • 🍼 Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents/primary caregivers, 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.
  • 💰 Plan for the future with a 401(k) plan featuring up to 4% company matching contributions, vesting immediately, to grow your retirement savings.
  • 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.

Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Nexthink’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all US locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Acquisition Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

About the Role

Acting as a trusted advisor to senior executives, you will translate market intelligence into actionable growth strategies, lead high-impact consulting engagements and drive revenue opportunities. You will also strengthen team capabilities, thought leadership and consulting excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Client Advisory: Advise senior stakeholders on market trends, competitive positioning, business challenges and growth opportunities.
  • Business Development: Identify and convert new business opportunities, develop strategic client relationships and contribute to revenue targets.
  • Growth Consulting: Lead executive Growth Dialogues and apply Frost & Sullivan’s Growth Pipeline Engine (GPE) to identify and accelerate client growth.

Required Competencies

The ideal candidate will have a strong educational foundation in business, economics, engineering or technology, coupled with a passion for solving complex problems and creating actionable insights for clients.

  • A bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Technology or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  • Typically, 9–11 years of experience in consulting, advisory, research or a related professional services environment.
  • Strong understanding of the Aerospace & Defense industry, including market dynamics, competitive landscapes and emerging technologies.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, analytical, research and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Proven ability to build senior client relationships, develop business opportunities and contribute to revenue growth.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated leadership in project delivery, team development and client advisory.

What will make you succeed at Frost & Sullivan?..

  • Be curious, entrepreneurial and open to new ideas.

  • Global Recognition - President’s Club & Chairman’s Club Awards

Frost & Sullivan, the Transformational Growth Journey Company, has spent more than 60 years partnering with clients to develop transformational growth strategies by focusing on innovation and growth opportunities driven by disruptive technologies, mega trends, emerging markets and new business models. Today, more than ever before, companies must innovate, not only to survive, but thrive in the future. This is your opportunity to be part of a revolutionary global team that truly inspires positive global changes by innovating to zero.

AIRS Medical is a fast-growing healthcare technology company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, with rapidly expanding U.S. EMEA and Japan operations. Built on the belief that technology should help prevent illness, not just treat it, AIRS Medical empowers people to live healthier, longer lives.

Our flagship solution, SwiftMR, is an FDA-cleared, cloud-based AI software that accelerates MRI scans by up to 50% without compromising diagnostic quality. Trusted by more than 350 hospitals and imaging centers across the U.S., including Lumexa Imaging, Northwestern Medicine, and MedStar Health / Georgetown University, SwiftMR enhances imaging efficiency, patient comfort, and clinical workflow.

AIRS Medical has been recognized with Frost & Sullivan’s Technology Innovation Leadership Awards (2023 and 2024) and as the winner of the Facebook AI Research and NYU Langone Health fastMRI Challenge (2019 and 2020), underscoring our leadership in deep learning and medical imaging AI.

As we continue expanding across globally, AIRS Medical remains committed to advancing AI and robotics innovations that enhance patient care, support healthcare professionals, and redefine diagnostic efficiency.

💼 Operations Manager
🌎 Open to Latin America: This role is open to candidates based in Latin America.
🏠 Remote

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing consumer goods brand with distribution across DTC, wholesale, Amazon, and US retail. US production, inventory, fulfilment, and logistics run through an outsourced 3PL and co-manufacturing partner, with an Australia-based team and a US Operations Director overseeing the overall plan.

About the Role

We're looking for an Operations Manager to own the day-to-day delivery of US production, inventory, fulfilment, and logistics through the 3PL and co-manufacturing partners. You'll set daily priorities, hold partners accountable to their commitments, resolve operational issues end to end, and give the Operations Director accurate reporting and practical recommendations.

This is a hands-on ownership role. You are not coordinating from a distance: you're the main day-to-day point of accountability for the 3PL and co-manufacturer relationships, multi-channel fulfilment, inventory accuracy, and financial controls.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the day-to-day relationship with the 3PL and co-manufacturer, aligning priorities, confirming commitments and deadlines, and holding partners accountable for delivery
  • Report on dispatches, aged orders, production, stock, and risks, including sales run rates against forecasts with variances flagged
  • Investigate missed commitments with evidence, drive recovery actions, and escalate capacity gaps and stockout risks before commitments are missed
  • Turn the approved production plan into agreed daily and weekly schedules, tracking actual units by SKU and component availability
  • Keep production jobs, purchase orders, receipts, and records accurate in Cin7, and document and resolve quality complaints with corrective actions
  • Manage DTC, wholesale, Faire, Amazon, and retail fulfilment, keeping PO versions, routing, BOL, ASN, and EDI records current
  • Resolve overdue, partial, replacement, and unscanned orders, and track domestic freight through to customer delivery
  • Coordinate stock counts and month-end reconciliations, and resolve discrepancies across Cin7, the 3PL's warehouse system, Shopify, Faire, and Amazon
  • Check 3PL, co-manufacturing, and freight charges against approved rates, document errors and losses, and give Finance accurate shipment costs and invoice follow-up
  • Improve recurring workflows to reduce manual effort and errors, document procedures, and verify AI-assisted outputs
  • Analyse fulfilment and freight costs by channel and check packaging and shipping assumptions for new products and bundles

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in fulfilment, logistics, inventory, or production, including experience managing US operations with US-based 3PLs, co-manufacturers, domestic carriers, and US retail and Amazon requirements
  • At least 2 to 3 years at manager level as the main day-to-day owner of an outsourced 3PL relationship, covering priorities, SLAs, stock accuracy, invoice checks, and partner accountability
  • At least 2 to 3 years at manager level as the main day-to-day owner of a co-manufacturer relationship, covering production scheduling, packaging, quality checks, and corrective actions
  • Evidence of independent ownership, such as a partner transition or turnaround you led, KPIs you were accountable for, disputes and credits you recovered, or escalations you brought with a recommendation
  • Confident with Cin7 or a comparable inventory system, Shopify, and 3PL warehouse management systems
  • Multi-channel fulfilment experience across DTC, wholesale, Amazon, and US retail, including routing guides, BOL, ASN, and EDI
  • Strong reconciliation and reporting skills with excellent Excel or Google Sheets
  • Clear, confident written and spoken English

Nice to Have

  • Experience in consumer products manufactured, warehoused, and shipped across multiple channels
  • Background in organic, health, or beauty consumer goods
  • Experience with month-end operations reviews and presenting KPI results and recommendations to senior leadership

Work Schedule

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
  • Availability during US Eastern Time business hours, plus regular calls with an Australia-based team during US late afternoon and evening

Compensation & Time Off

  • Compensation paid in USD
  • Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
  • Paid Time Off according to company policy
  • Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  • An updated resume
  • A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your 3PL and co-manufacturer management experience, and walking through a specific operational problem you owned and resolved end to end with evidence

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Job Title: Study Start-up Manager

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Study Start Up Hub – Study Start-up Mgr

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will drive the planning and execution of clinical study start-up activities, ensuring trials are launched efficiently, compliantly, and to the highest quality standards.

  • Lead the planning and delivery of clinical study start-up activities from global to local, ensuring timelines, quality, budget, and regulatory compliance are met.

  • Own and manage study start-up plans and milestones, maintaining oversight of progress and resolving issues to keep delivery on track.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for cross-functional start-up teams, driving clarity of roles, accountability, and collaboration.

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate risks proactively, contributing to study risk assessments and ensuring timely study start.

  • Partner closely with Study Delivery Leads, managers, and local teams, providing clear updates, solutions, and escalation where needed.

  • Apply strong operational and regulatory knowledge (e.g. ICH-GCP, submissions and start-up processes) to enable high-quality execution.

  • Manage internal resources and external suppliers to ensure efficient and compliant delivery of start-up activities.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing expertise, mentoring colleagues, and developing best practices within the SSU hub.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is an individual with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Pharma Expertise: Requires pharma and clinical trial processes and operations expertise; no relevant therapeutic knowledge required

  • Management Experience: Requires experience leading and managing global teams and project management experience

  • Tech Skills: No prior Veeva experience required

raw.title: Legal Content Marketer (DE/AT)
raw.excerpt: About BEAMONBEAMON is the AI workspace for lawyers.
raw.description:
About BEAMON

BEAMON is the AI workspace for lawyers. Draft, review and research with legal AI you can trust, connected to the legal content lawyers already rely on and to a workflow engine that turns AI output into finished legal work.

700 clients in 10 months. That is how fast law firms and legal teams are moving to BEAMON.

  • Built for lawyers, not adapted for them. Assist, Draft (in Word) and Extract cover the daily work: research, drafting, redlining, contract review at scale.

  • Content no one else has. We were the fastest growing independent European AI assistant to integrate content from legal publishers, starting with Dr. Otto Schmidt.

  • The European challenger. Others have the headlines. We grow fast anyways.

The master plan:

  1. Own DACH. Become the default legal AI for every small and medium law firms and legal teams in Germany and Austria.

  2. Win multiple verticals. Lawyers, legal teams, notaries and municipalities. We help small teams win big – with BEAMON.

  3. Set the standard. Make BEAMON the benchmark for how legal experts work with AI.

We're early. Most of the work is ahead of us, so we are building a world-class team.

The opportunity: Legal Content Marketer

Your job: make BEAMON the first name a German-speaking lawyer thinks of when they think legal AI. And the first answer ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google give when they ask.

You'll start by taking over our content engine: blog, newsletter, website. You'll make it sharper, faster and impossible to ignore. Then you'll take the stage beyond our own channels: AI thought leadership with global publishers, syndication, and video success stories with our clients.

You're a legal expert who fell for marketing. You know how a Kanzlei partner reads, what an in-house counsel actually cares about, and why "AI will replace lawyers" is the worst headline you can write. That legal instinct is your unfair advantage.

This is an early-career role with senior-level ownership. You'll learn fast because you'll touch everything: SEO, AEO, video, PR, analytics. Nobody will hand you a content calendar. You build it.

Every piece we publish meets YOUR standard. You set the bar. If you nail it, you'll grow into leading content and brand for BEAMON as we scale across Europe.

Full-time, remote, based in Germany or Austria. Hybrid if you are in Vienna.

This role requires speed, but also extremely high quality standards. You’ll report to me, Chris (Head of Growth). I ask a lot and together we will achieve a lot.

You'll work closely with me (Chris, Head of Growth) and the teams in Marketing, Sales, and Product.

What you'll own

Because of you, lawyers and legal teams discover BEAMON, understand it and start a trial.

  • Content engine. You create, publish and distribute blog posts, newsletters, landing pages, social posts and campaign assets. Fast, accurate, never boring. Your legal background allows you to understand how lawyers think and work.

  • Discoverability (SEO + AEO). You write for humans and for AI crawlers. You own the targets: rankings, AI answer share, organic traffic. When a lawyer asks an AI which legal AI to use, BEAMON is in the answer.

  • Thought leadership. You land BEAMON's voice on AI and the future of legal work with global and legal publishers, and you run content syndication.

  • Video success stories. You're the operational project manager: you get clients excited to tell their story, brief the agency, run the logistics and ship the film.

  • Brand and share of voice. You build the BEAMON brand at its core and track how it stacks up against others. Every month.

How we measure success

Your success shows in brand recognition and pipeline.

KPIs:

Primary | Content-sourced pipeline: Trials and demos where content was was a touchpoint Secondary| AI share of voice: Share of relevant AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI) that name BEAMON vs. incumbents
Organic traffic: Monthly organic sessions, DACH Video success stories Client videos live per quarter Newsletter engagement: Open and click rate

Need to have

  • Legal background. A degree in law or a related field. You love the law, and you can tell a sharp legal argument from AI slop in one read. We love to share how many lawyers work in GTM at BEAMON!

  • Content. Professional experience in content marketing. You've shipped some really cool stuff and got great results.

  • Bold. You're not intimidated by competition. You want to beat them.

  • Curious. You keep up with all things tech, especially SEO, AEO and video. You've tried the newest AI tools before we ask.

  • Ownership. Strong work ethic. You don't wait for a brief, and you don't get blocked.

  • Languages and location. Native German, English at C1 or better. Based in Germany or Austria.

Extra points for

  • SaaS. Experience in B2B SaaS, tech or professional services.

  • Publishers and agencies. You've worked with publishing houses or agencies and know how to get the best out of them.

  • Syndication. You've run content syndication before.

  • Tooling. Hands-on with AirOps, Ahrefs or Semrush.

  • Data. You enjoy performance tracking and marketing ops. A dashboard doesn't scare you.

What you get

  • A competitive salary according to your seniority level.

  • VSOP shares in the company

  • Learning budget, hardware, wellbeing contribution and more.

  • Exposure across every area of legal AI marketing, and a fast track to grow with BEAMON.

raw.excerpt: Summary The AI Integration & Automation Developer designs, builds, tests, and supports AI-enabled integrations and automation solutions that improve the efficiency, scalability, and quality of Managed Services operations.
raw.description:
Summary


The AI Integration & Automation Developer designs, builds, tests, and supports AI-enabled integrations and automation solutions that improve the efficiency, scalability, and quality of Managed Services operations. This role is delivery-focused and hands-on, translating operational problems into practical automation and AI workflow solutions that reduce manual effort, improve service consistency, and create measurable business value.

This position requires strong critical thinking, curiosity about emerging AI automation capabilities, and the ability to evaluate where AI, orchestration, scripting, workflow automation, or traditional process improvement will drive the best outcome. The developer will work closely with technical and operational stakeholders and may receive dotted-line technical guidance from the AI Integration & Automation Engineer.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Integration & Automation Development

  • Designs, develops, and maintains AI-enabled automations, integrations, and workflow solutions supporting Managed Services.
  • Builds practical AI orchestration patterns that connect systems, data, prompts, APIs, scripts, and operational workflows.
  • Develops automation solutions that reduce manual work, improve service delivery speed, increase consistency, or create measurable cost avoidance.
  • Creates reusable components, connectors, scripts, and workflow patterns that can be leveraged across multiple use cases.
  • Supports implementation of internal AI Orchestration capabilities and related automation services as part of the Managed Services automation portfolio.

Critical Thinking & Operational Problem Solving

  • Analyzes operational pain points and determines whether AI, automation, integration, process improvement, or a combination of approaches is the best solution.
  • Identifies automation opportunities that address systemic problems, not only isolated manual tasks.
  • Balances experimentation with production stability, supportability, security, and operational readiness.
  • Uses data, outcome measures, and stakeholder feedback to validate whether automation work is creating efficiency gains or business value.

AI Automation Delivery & Support

  • Develops LLM-enabled workflows, agentic automation patterns, and AI-assisted operational processes with appropriate guardrails and fallback logic.
  • Integrates with enterprise tools, monitoring platforms, ITSM systems, cloud services, and internal applications as needed.
  • Troubleshoots automation defects, integration failures, and AI workflow issues, driving durable fixes and continuous improvement.
  • Documents solution design, configuration, support steps, ownership, and knowledge articles to reduce key-person dependency.
  • Participates in testing, UAT, release readiness, change control, and production support activities for automation solutions.

Managed Services, ITIL & Collaboration

  • Applies awareness of Managed Services delivery models, ITIL processes, and operational impact when designing automation solutions.
  • Collaborates with engineers, service owners, process owners, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and validate outcomes.
  • Communicates technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Stays current on emerging AI automation development practices, AI orchestration patterns, LLM tooling, integration frameworks, and service operations trends.

General

  • Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through behaviors consistent with the organization's values.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical, and professional behaviors.
  • Supports and conducts self in a manner consistent with customer service expectations.

Supervisory Responsibilities


This job has no supervisory responsibilities. The role may receive dotted-line technical guidance from senior AI automation resources and may collaborate with other developers, engineers, and process owners.

Qualifications


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Education/Experience/Technical Requirements/Certifications


Equivalent combination accepted.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, software engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

Experience / Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience developing automations, integrations, scripts, workflows, or application solutions in enterprise or services environments.
  • Hands-on experience with automation development using tools or languages such as Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, APIs, workflow platforms, or low-code/no-code automation tools.
  • Experience designing or supporting AI-enabled workflows, LLM-driven processes, AI agents, orchestration patterns, or intelligent automation solutions.
  • Understanding of prompt design, structured outputs, human-in-the-loop patterns, guardrails, fallback logic, and practical considerations for production AI use cases.
  • Experience integrating with operational platforms such as ITSM tools, monitoring/observability tools, cloud platforms, ticketing systems, knowledge bases, or internal business applications.
  • Ability to analyze business or operational processes and convert requirements into working automation solutions.
  • Working knowledge of Managed Services operations, ITIL practices, or service management processes is preferred.
  • Experience with cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP is preferred.
  • Experience with data pipelines, vector databases, embeddings, event-driven workflows, or containerized environments is a plus.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and implement sustainable fixes.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across technical and operational teams.

Certifications

  • Certifications related to AI, automation, cloud platforms, ITIL, or service management are preferred but not required.

(Examples may include Microsoft Azure AI Engineer, Azure Administrator Associate, AWS certifications, ITIL Foundation, or relevant automation/platform certifications.)

Other Skills and Abilities

  • Critical thinker with the ability to challenge assumptions, evaluate options, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Curious and current on emerging AI automation development practices, orchestration frameworks, and service operations technology trends.
  • Outcome-oriented mindset focused on measurable efficiency gains, cost avoidance, quality improvement, and operational scalability.
  • Ability to operate as a hands-on developer while collaborating effectively with senior technical resources and business stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation discipline, including solution design, support procedures, ownership details, release notes, and knowledge articles.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and production stability.
  • Comfortable experimenting, learning quickly, failing fast, and iterating toward durable solutions.

Physical Demands


The physical demands described here are representative of those that should be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is constantly required to sit, talk, see, hear, and use hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand; move about, climb steps or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this classification. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of personnel so classified.
