About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at

About Our Team

Our Strategic Solutions team is an overlay sales organization that partners with core sales representatives across strategic, national, and alliance accounts. We bring deep subject-matter expertise, customer data assessments, consultative presentations, and solution knowledge to complex client opportunities, while working closely with Market Planning and other partners to identify market requirements and help shape new solutions.

About the Role

As a Strategic Account Executive focused on Customer Data Management, you will serve as a consultative overlay specialist and trusted subject-matter expert to clients and internal sales teams. You will analyze customer data, communicate findings related to data quality, linking, duplicates, and potential risk indicators, and translate those findings into clear business value and strategic recommendations.

This role requires a combination of deep customer and business data expertise with strong presentation, interpersonal, and relationship-development skills. You will also collaborate with Sales, Market Planning, Product, Marketing, Operations, and Delivery teams to support customer opportunities and influence solution development, with a significant focus on Financial Crime Compliance use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with core sales representatives across strategic, national, and alliance accounts as a Customer Data Management subject-matter expert and consultative overlay specialist.
  • Lead customer data assessments that evaluate data quality, record linking, duplicate rates, and related issues, then explain findings and business implications to clients.
  • Deliver detailed, in-depth client presentations and strategic recommendations that demonstrate the value of LexisNexis Risk Solutions capabilities.
  • Build trusted relationships with client executives, key decision-makers, core sales representatives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Apply expertise in entity resolution, customer data linking, data quality management, and Financial Crime Compliance to shape client solutions and advance opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Market Planning to identify market requirements, develop Financial Crime Compliance-focused solutions, and support product and solution innovation.
  • Understand customer business challenges and translate complex technical and analytical concepts into clear, actionable business solutions.
  • Partner with Sales, Product, Marketing, Operations, and Delivery teams to develop solutions and support effective transition and execution.
  • Identify new market and customer opportunities and contribute to strategies that expand relationships and generate revenue.
  • Manage multiple customer engagements and priorities while balancing deadlines and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Travel approximately 10% and communicate effectively across all levels of management and functional teams.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of B2B sales, business development, solution consulting, or related experience within technology, data, analytics, or a service-oriented organization.
  • Deep, current experience with customer or business data and the ability to contribute substantive subject-matter expertise in client and internal conversations.
  • Experience with Customer Data Management, Master Data Management, data quality management, entity resolution, customer data linking, or related data solutions.
  • Knowledge of Financial Crime Compliance use cases and the ability to connect customer data capabilities to Anti-Money Laundering, fraud, identity, or related risk challenges.
  • Strong consultative sales experience and demonstrated success supporting complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities.
  • Ability to analyze data assessment findings and explain technical concepts, conclusions, and business value clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, persuasion, and relationship-development skills, including the ability to lead lengthy, in-depth client presentations.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish credibility as a trusted subject-matter expert and collaborate effectively with core sales teams and cross-functional partners.
  • Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Working for You

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Health Benefits: Comprehensive, multi-carrier program for medical, dental and vision benefits
  • Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with match and an Employee Share Purchase Plan

  • Family Benefits, including bonding and family care leaves, adoption and surrogacy benefits
  • Health Savings, Health Care, Dependent Care and Commuter Spending Accounts
  • In addition to annual Paid Time Off, we offer up to two days of paid leave each to participate in Employee Resource Groups and to volunteer with your charity of choice

raw.title: Sales Development Representative
raw.excerpt: Position Type: Full-Time | Remote Working Hours: Canadian Business Hours About the RoleWe’re looking for a proactive and results-driven Sales Development Representative (SDR) to build a strong sales pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting and lead qualification.
raw.description:
Position Type: Full-Time | Remote

Working Hours: Canadian Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive and results-driven Sales Development Representative (SDR) to build a strong sales pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting and lead qualification. You’ll connect with potential customers through cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn, identify qualified opportunities, and book meetings for the sales team.

The ideal candidate is an independent, organized, and coachable sales professional who takes ownership of their outreach targets, communicates confidently with prospects, and continuously improves their approach based on results and feedback.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Identify and engage potential customers through cold calls, personalized emails, and LinkedIn outreach.
  • Research prospects to ensure they align with the company's ideal customer profile.
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of potential sales opportunities.
  • Prioritize daily outreach activities and follow-ups to maximize prospect engagement.

Lead Qualification & Meeting Booking

  • Conduct discovery conversations with inbound and outbound prospects to understand their needs, assess fit, and determine readiness to move forward.
  • Ask relevant questions to identify qualified opportunities and determine appropriate next steps.
  • Schedule and confirm meetings for account executives or senior sales team members.
  • Provide clear notes and context to ensure smooth handoffs to the sales team.

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Record outreach activities, update contact information, and maintain accurate CRM records.
  • Track pipeline progress, prospect responses, and follow-up requirements.
  • Ensure all interactions and next steps are documented consistently.
  • Manage daily outreach and follow-up sequences without close supervision.

Sales Messaging & Optimization

  • Test and refine outreach messages and sequences based on response rates and prospect feedback.
  • Share insights from sales conversations to help improve messaging and targeting.
  • Incorporate feedback from the sales team to strengthen outreach effectiveness.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve engagement and meeting-booking rates.

Market & Prospect Research

  • Research target customer profiles, industry trends, and the competitive landscape.
  • Use relevant prospect insights to personalize outreach and make conversations more meaningful.
  • Develop a clear understanding of the target market to support effective prospect qualification.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in sales development, business development, or outbound prospecting.
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding outreach activity and pipeline targets.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Experience with cold calling, email outreach, and LinkedIn prospecting.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms and sales pipeline management.
  • Ability to manage daily outreach volume, prioritize tasks, and work independently.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-up habits.
  • Coachable mindset and willingness to refine sales techniques based on feedback and performance.

Perfect Fit / Culture

  • You take ownership of your targets and consistently follow through on commitments.
  • You are curious about prospects, ask thoughtful questions, and can recognize when an opportunity is not a good fit.
  • You communicate proactively and flag blockers before they affect results.
  • You treat rejection as an opportunity to learn and improve.
  • You are comfortable working remotely in an independent, primarily asynchronous environment.

Typical Day

You’ll start by reviewing your prospect list and prioritizing follow-ups. Throughout the day, you’ll conduct cold calls, send personalized emails and LinkedIn messages, and research potential customers. You’ll keep CRM records updated, qualify interested prospects, and book meetings for the sales team. You may also join brief team check-ins to share prospect feedback, refine messaging, and improve outreach strategies.

Interview Process

  1. AI Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

Job Title: Sales Engineer

Position Type: Permanent

Location: France

Work model: remote

Language requirement: Fluent French & English


Who We Are

At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best-in-class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out-of-the-box thinkers who appreciate the art of great software and how it revolutionizes the world in which we live.

To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they’ve always been done.


What We’re Looking For

Our people are our most important resource. We’re looking for an experienced Sales Engineer who specialises in MDM solutions to join our growing team in France.


What’s in it for you?


The People - Our people are our most important resource. From our humble origins in our founder’s basement to our industry-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation and fun.

The Growth - Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big!

The Technology - You’ll work with leading-edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects, as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners, including leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.


What You Will Do

  • Develop and grow revenue through consultative selling with clients and prospects, presenting a warm, professional, well-spoken, and caring persona as an effective representative of SOTI.
  • Provide email and telephone-based presales technical support for our software products.
  • Perform production demonstrations that articulate the business and technical value of SOTI solutions.
  • Collaborating with the regional sales team consultatively with clients/stakeholders. Helping them to envision the possibility of mobility.
  • Educate on and facilitate SOTI solutions that can effectively address business and technical outcomes, positioning business value to customer organizations' decision-makers.
  • Present the solution architecture, including all technical aspects of the product and supporting systems.
  • Provide pre-sales technical support, installing and configuring enterprise software solutions during POC to prospective customers.
  • Communicate with internal product development teams to resolve product issues & generate recommendations for product roadmaps (feature requests).
  • Assist with the execution of internal team projects and initiatives.

Experience You Will Bring

  • Minimum of 4-5 years of work experience with experience related to mobile device management solutions and enterprise mobility (Android, iOS, Linux, Windows), BYOD, SaaS
  • Prior experience working in a technical customer-facing role. Ideally, as a pre-sales / sales engineer.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with a demonstrated ability to communicate the complexities of technical programs.
  • Knowledge of computer networking principles (DNS, IP network, Firewalls, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Single Sign-On (SSO), Identity Application Management (IAM), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), the Identity provider (IdP),
  • Knowledge of certificate authorities, certificate management & distribution, and encryption methodologies (SHA1/2, TLS, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Active Directory, LDAP protocol, and identity management systems.
  • Understanding and experience with Databases (i.e., MS SQL server, MY-SQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Understanding and/or knowledge of business processes & sales cycle
  • Knowledge of containerization and virtualization.
  • Work autonomously with minimum supervision.
  • Able to plan, prioritize and organize workload, consistently working within service standards and agreed objectives.

Nice to Have

  • Cisco Certified Network Associate or equivalent.
  • Microsoft Certified Technology Specialist (MCTS) - Exchange or equivalent experience.
  • Understanding or knowledge of Cloud Computing or certification like AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate.
  • Android Enterprise Professional.
  • Any formal sales training - value selling, SPIN, Miller Heiman.
  • Understanding of Rest APIs and coding (i.e., Java Scripting, HTML, etc.)
  • Experience with customer service / Incident management software.
  • Multilingual capabilities.

About SOTI


SOTI is the world's most trusted provider of mobile and IoT management solutions, with more than 17,000 enterprise customers and millions of devices managed worldwide. SOTI's innovative portfolio of solutions and services provides the tools organizations need to truly mobilize their operations and optimize their mobility investments. SOTI extends secure mobility management to provide a total, flexible solution for comprehensive management and security of all mobile devices and connected peripherals deployed in an organization.


At SOTI, we celebrate the uniqueness of our global teams and are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are curious problem solvers who are committed to bringing the best mobile and IoT management solutions to market. We offer careers with #EndlessPossibilities.


What are you waiting for? Apply today:

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

Role Overview: The Senior Clinical Training Specialist supports the corporate provider network training strategy with a focus on clinical provider education and external communications support.

Work Arrangement:

  • Remote – This position is fully remote position and can be performed from any location within the United States (US).
  • Availability required during Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours
  • Reliable high‑speed internet required (minimum 50 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload)
  • Associates residing in states where reimbursement is required by contract, law, or regulation may submit eligible expenses for reimbursement

Responsibilities:

  • Supports the planning, development, and coordination of Project ECHO and related provider education activities across health plan and market-facing programs.
  • Participates as part of the operations team hosting provider training in a coordinator or facilitation role to support smooth session flow, presenter readiness, participant engagement, and stakeholder experience.
  • Maintains program materials, planning documents, trackers, attendance records, evaluation files, and communication tools needed to support organized program delivery.
  • Tracks timelines, action items, follow-up needs, and deliverable status across concurrent ECHO series, provider education programs, and cross-functional workgroups.
  • Collects and reviews basic program data, including registration, attendance, evaluation completion, satisfaction scores, content review status, and completion status.
  • Communicate professionally with internal and external stakeholders, presenters, planning teams, health plan partners, and subject matter experts to gather materials and keep deliverables moving forward.
  • Prepares summaries, tables, trackers, and status updates to support leadership review, program follow-up, trend review, and improvement discussions.
  • Incorporates enterprise All In behavioral standards in all training and evaluation activities.

Education & Experience:

  • ​​Bachelor’s degree required
  • Master’s Degree preferred
  • Clinical background, Registered Nurse (RN), or licensed Social Worker highly preferred
  • 3 or more years of experience in training delivery, facilitation, and classroom management required; experience supporting provider education, clinical operations, clinical training, provider network management, managed care operations, or provider-facing clinical programs preferred.​

Skills & Abilities:

  • Experience in training development and delivery in live and virtual environments
  • Experience in webinar/conferencing tools (Zoom and/or Teams), and comfortable presenting on camera
  • Strong training material management, tracking/reporting, & LMS capabilities
  • Effective communication/engagement with individuals and groups
  • Introductory knowledge of project management principles / methodologies and application
  • Knowledge of adult learning theory or principles
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite of products
  • Working knowledge of SharePoint, and Provider Portal

Grounded in a talent-centric mindset, Maker Lab is a marketing agency designed to build decentralised technology-led agency teams, rooted in collaboration with clients from the ground up. Maker Lab’s cross-functional teams of multidisciplinary specialists are embedded into client teams across digital marketing competencies — from measurement & analytics to content production.

Marketing Manager (Performance Marketing)

Maker Lab supports clients across technology, entertainment, financial services and the payments industry. We’re looking for dynamic individuals to join our team and support our amazing clients in the tech industry. This role functions as the operational Command Centre for the Direct Response program. The specialist is responsible for managing multi-channel investment across the entire digital ecosystem, ensuring all activity is balanced, paced, and performing optimally. They serve as the critical bridge between high-level strategy and the technical execution delivered by agency partners across all major digital touchpoints, driving operational excellence by defining the methods and timelines ("the how and the when") for strategic implementation.

This role requires you to work in an APAC-friendly time zone, starting at 5:30 a.m. IST.

Contract Duration - Fixed Term - 6 months

Role:

  • Translate high-level product strategies into comprehensive and actionable media briefs, serving as the central point of contact for media agency activation and operations teams to ensure flawless campaign execution.
  • Develop and manage multi-channel traffic and conversion forecasts, continually monitor real-time investment pacing, and identify opportunities for optimisation or anomaly resolution. This includes proactively tracking GStore inventory and flagging out-of-stock (OOS) risks.
  • Own the roadmap for the Learning Agenda, coordinating the execution of A/B testing, experimentation, and creative refreshes with agency partners, and ensuring all results are meticulously documented and integrated into the overarching strategy.
  • Consolidate complex performance data across the digital stack to create a clear, data-driven narrative on traffic and sales performance. Establish a regular Direct Response (DR) reporting cadence for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, providing key learnings and strategic recommendations.
  • Drive operational excellence by defining methods and timelines for strategic implementation and ensuring seamless coordination among product, marketing, and sales teams.
  • Ensure all digital marketing activities comply with internal policies, privacy regulations, and brand safety guidelines.

You:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience
  • 6+ years of experience in Performance Marketing or Paid Media Operations, with a documented track record of driving bottom-of-funnel conversions (sales/activations).
  • Hands-on experience or deep oversight of performance media buying via platforms like Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube).
  • Experience designing and managing structured Learning Agendas (A/B testing, incrementality testing).
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel and the ability to synthesise raw data into performance narratives.
  • Proven ability to manage complex forecasting and budget pacing for high-spend accounts.
  • Experience working directly with media agencies, including writing briefs and holding teams accountable to KPIs and pacing.
  • Experience in the consumer electronics industry or high-volume e-commerce.
  • Expert-level knowledge of full-stack media platforms.
  • Familiarity with analytics and data visualisation tools for building automated performance dashboards.
  • Experience managing media across multiple markets.
  • Exceptional verbal and written English communication and presentation skills.

Please note: due to the high volume of applications, only successful candidates will be contacted with a follow-up introduction email. If you do not receive an email from Maker Lab, your application has been unsuccessful this time around. Look out for future roles! By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your data by the Maker Lab team for the purposes of your application. Where your application contains personal data of third parties, you confirm that you have obtained all necessary consents to provide the Maker Lab team with such personal data and that we may collect, use and/or disclose such data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012.

raw.description:
Ciklum is looking for an Expert Business Analyst to join our team full-time in the US .

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As an Expert Business Analyst, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. The aim of which is consolidation of multiple payment gateways into one target gateway platform. Strong USA Payments domain expertise and hands-on experience with TSYS card acquiring platforms is mandatory for the candidate in this role. The candidate will work closely with Business Stakeholders, Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Development, Migration and QA Teams. Hands-on experience with payment platform migrations, the SAFe environment, and working at the Program level is highly preferable.

Responsibilities:

  • Elicit, analyze, and document business, functional, non-functional and transition requirements through business and technical stakeholder discussions, workshops and reverse engineering
  • Create and maintain BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and data process flows
  • Create documentation enabling the technical teams: Solution Architecture, Development, Data and Migration teams
  • Work closely with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Developers, Data and Migration Engineers, QA, and business teams throughout the SDLC
  • Provide functional expertise across the US Payment landscape, focusing on the gateway technical processing rather than card products and e2e payments for the customer's
  • Provide expertise with TSYS/card processing platforms and understand processor integrations and downstream systems
  • Analyze change requests, perform impact analysis, and identify and manage dependencies across streams
  • Manage requirements at the Program level
  • Conduct data analysis, data mapping, and scenario planning for the migration
  • Support migration and UAT planning, test case reviews, defect triage, and production releases
  • Collaborate with QA teams to ensure requirements are completely covered through functional and integration testing
  • Define and document non-functional requirements in collaboration with the Solution Architects and the QA team
  • Work with APIs, data flows, interfaces, and system integrations to translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Actively plan and drive SAFe ceremonies including backlog refinement, PI and sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demos, and retrospectives
  • Maintain requirements traceability from business requirements through development, testing, and migration completion
  • Support investigation and resolution of production issues and business queries
  • Work with payment networks and industry standards, including Visa, Mastercard, and relevant regulatory/compliance requirements

Requirements:

  • Deep and wide knowledge of the USA Payment landscape
  • Payment processor background
  • Strong knowledge of the TSYS Acquiring platforms (such as Saratoga, Sierra, Summit); TSYS BETs and TSYS PPM
  • Knowledge of TSYS EIS 1080 (Authorization) and EIS 1081 (Settlement & Clearing)
  • Understanding of the card scheme rules, transactions (such as tipping, surcharges, split billing, DCC / FX at POS); Terminal vendor protocols Verifone, Ingenico etc
  • Understanding of card authorization, clearing, settlement, chargebacks, and reconciliation
  • Experience with tokenization and digital wallets such as Apple Pay and Google Pay
  • Experience working with Visa/Mastercard mandates and compliance changes
  • Experience with payment fraud, risk, or regulatory initiatives
  • Strong experience with data mapping and migration of complex platforms
  • SQL knowledge for data validation and analysis
  • 7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst / Business Systems Analyst
  • Deep expertise in the USA Payments domain, including regulatory compliance (such as ACH, PCI, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with TSYS card acquiring platforms
  • Technical background: SQL, API, system integrations, data flows, data analysis and mapping
  • Basic understanding of architecture principles
  • Experience with requirements elicitation and documentation, creation of BRD, FRD, user stories, acceptance criteria, process and data flows at the appropriate technical level
  • Experience with UAT, integration testing, defect management, and release support
  • Strong proven experience leveraging AI throughout the SDLC and BA/SA workflows, quickly adapting to the wide variety of AI tools
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum/SAFe environments
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence, Azure DevOps
  • Ability to maintain at least six (6) hours of daily working-hour overlap with North American business hours (approximately 09:00–17:00 across the US Eastern to Pacific time zones)

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: Healthcare, Basic Life Insurance, Short and Long-term disability insurance according to the Company’s Benefit Plans

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. In the US, Ciklum is growing fast—inviting experienced professionals to lead digital transformation alongside Fortune 500 clients. Be part of a company where innovation and impact go hand in hand.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

Data Engineer V


Leads the technical direction, delivery standards, and day-to-day execution of a data engineering pod — spanning core EDW pipelines and AI/RAG data infrastructure — translating stakeholder needs into a prioritized roadmap while mentoring engineers and owning operational accountability for the team's pipelines.

Required Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 8–12 years of experience in technology, with significant data-centric leadership.
  • 6–8 years hands-on experience architecting data solutions on a cloud platform.
  • 2+ years formally leading engineers or technical workstreams.

Preferred

  • Cloud Professional Data Engineer or ML Engineer certification.
  • Experience with healthcare data compliance frameworks (HIPAA, HL7, FHIR).
  • Experience setting standards for LLM/RAG data architecture at scale.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Expert-level SQL, data modeling, and semantic-layer design; sets standards for the team's schema/pipeline design patterns.
  • Sets the team's approach to batch/streaming architecture (Spark, Airflow, Databricks/Snowflake) and CI/CD practices.
  • Sets standards for the team's AI/RAG data pipelines (embedding strategy, vector-store selection, corpus curation) and AI-assisted development practices.
  • Directs and mentors a team of engineers; manages workload prioritization and on-time delivery.
  • Translates business ambiguity into actionable technical plans; regularly presents to stakeholders and audiences of 10+.
  • Coordinates handoffs with adjacent technical teams (data science, security, compliance) to ensure platform readiness.
  • Enforces security/privacy standards, including AI-specific risk considerations, across the team's work.

Job Functions

  • Lead and mentor a team/pod of engineers, prioritizing workload and driving on-time, Agile delivery.
  • Own source-management, version-control, and QA/testing standards for the team, including standards for AI-assisted code contributions.
  • Define and track the team's metrics strategy; own SLA/SLO tracking for pipelines and lead "back-to-green" plans when KPIs are missed.
  • Track, analyze, and report KPIs (pipeline uptime, MTTR, data-quality metrics) to leadership.
  • Own root-cause analysis and mitigation for complex pipeline/data-quality issues within the team's scope.
  • Serve as a primary technical liaison to business/clinical stakeholders, translating needs into the team's roadmap (pipelines, data products, AI/RAG capabilities).
  • Contribute cost/budget input for the team's cloud and AI/vector-database usage.
  • Own documentation, SOPs, and escalation pathways for the team.
  • Participate in and help coordinate the on-call rotation, owning escalation ownership when issues arise.
Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. The compensation range for this position ranges from $165,830.00/year in our lowest geographic market up to 243,141.80 USD/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Learn more about benefits at Rackspace.

About Rackspace Technology

Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. We support customers in more than 120 countries with AI capabilities spanning private cloud, public cloud, applications, data and cyber resilience.


More on Rackspace Technology

Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. We welcome you to apply today and want you to know that we are committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender reassignment or identity or expression, genetic information, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, military or veteran status, nationality, ethnic or national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any legally protected characteristic. Reporting to the Chief People Officer, the Vice President, People Business Partners (VP, PBPs) will lead Rocket Software's global PBP team, establishing the vision, standards, and operating model for strategic people partnership across the business. As a trusted advisor to senior leaders, the role will own the talent agenda that enables Rocket to achieve its business objectives, ensuring the company has the right talent, in the right place, at the right cost to drive long-term success.


The VP, PBPs will elevate PBPs to operate as workforce architects, leveraging business strategy, workforce analytics, and external market insights to shape organizational design, anticipate future capability needs, and guide decisions about how, where, and at what cost work is performed. This leader will translate enterprise people strategy into scalable talent and organizational solutions that strengthen leadership effectiveness, accelerate performance, enhance employee engagement, and support organizational agility in a rapidly evolving environment.


Working closely with leaders across the People Team and the business, the Vice President will drive consistent people practices globally, strengthen change readiness, and foster a high-performing, inclusive culture. The Vice President will set the standard for strategic business partnership by combining sound judgment, data-driven decision-making, and innovative thinking to deliver meaningful people and business outcomes.

Company Overview


Shriners Children’s is an organization that respects, supports, and values each other. Named as the 2025 best mid-sized employer by Forbes, we are engaged in providing excellence in patient care, embracing multi-disciplinary education, and research with global impact. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. Our compassion, integrity, accountability, and resilience define us as leaders in pediatric specialty care for our children and their families.


With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.


CURRENT EMPLOYEES: Please log into Workday Click Here to apply internally through the "Jobs Hub"


Job Description


The Manager, Financial Services will focus on providing financial support to the Shriners Children’s Medical Group (SCMG) West Region and assigned ambulatory practice locations.

This role requires an analytical and strategic professional to oversee key operational and financial functions, including operational financial analysis, budget management, data analysis, and other business/financial support to meet the organization’s growth and financial performance objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Acts as an advisor to assigned regional/local operational and medical group leadership teams by proactively identifying opportunities to optimize revenue/collections and efficiently manage expenses.
  • Develops, monitors and optimizes the budget to ensure effective resource allocation and organizational efficiency.

  • Requires strong data analysis capabilities to interpret complex datasets, generate actionable insights, and produce reports that guide business strategy. Additionally, the role requires ability to communicate this guidance to regional and local leadership teams in a highly effective manner.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure data-driven decision-making across the organization. The role requires ability to work with a high level of collaboration with key stakeholders across a matrixed organization.
  • Involved in the monthly general ledger closing process and variance reporting for assigned areas.
  • Involved in oversight and monitoring of local revenue cycle charge capture processes in collaboration with local leaders and Home Office.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 years of accounting or finance experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in business/accounting/finance or healthcare/business administration or equivalent experience in lieu of degree

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree
  • Healthcare finance experience
  • EPIC and/or Workday experience

Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity.

raw.description:
Role Overview

The L3 DevOps / Cloud Engineer will act as a senior technical resource responsible for leading complex infrastructure and DevOps activities, driving automation, defining technical standards, and improving platform reliability.

The role requires strong hands-on expertise in AWS, Terraform, AWX/Ansible, ArgoCD, GitOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and Disaster Recovery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the L3 escalation point for complex Cloud, DevOps, Kubernetes, infrastructure, and deployment issues.
  • Lead major technical activities across production and non-production environments.
  • Take ownership of complex infrastructure changes, upgrades, migrations, and platform improvements.
  • Lead and coordinate Disaster Recovery (DR) activities, including:
    • DR planning
    • Restore testing
    • Failover/failback activities
    • Application and infrastructure recovery
    • DR validation
    • Runbook preparation and improvement
  • Design and implement infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules.
  • Review Terraform code and infrastructure changes implemented by L1/L2 engineers.
  • Define Terraform coding standards, repository structure, and implementation best practices.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWX / Ansible.
  • Develop reusable Ansible roles, playbooks, and automation workflows.
  • Use AWX to automate:
    • Server configuration
    • Patching
    • Application deployment
    • Infrastructure operations
    • Repetitive BAU activities
  • Identify manual operational activities and convert them into automated workflows.
  • Design and maintain ArgoCD-based deployments.
  • Implement and support GitOps practices for Kubernetes and application deployments.
  • Define GitOps repository structures and deployment standards.
  • Manage and troubleshoot ArgoCD:
    • Applications
    • Sync issues
    • Configuration drift
    • Deployment failures
    • Environment promotion
    • Rollback activities
  • Design and maintain Kubernetes workloads running on Amazon EKS.
  • Develop and maintain reusable Helm Charts.
  • Define standards for Helm values, templates, and environment-specific configurations.
  • Design and improve CI/CD deployment processes.
  • Support and improve Jenkins and other CI/CD automation.
  • Define deployment strategies and operational standards.
  • Lead automation initiatives across Cloud and DevOps platforms.
  • Develop automation using:
    • Terraform
    • Ansible / AWX
    • Bash
    • Python
    • CI/CD pipelines
  • Define and enforce technical standards for:
    • Infrastructure as Code
    • Terraform
    • GitOps
    • Kubernetes
    • Helm
    • CI/CD
    • Automation
    • Cloud operations
    • Patching
    • Deployment processes
  • Establish reusable templates, modules, pipelines, and automation frameworks.
  • Perform technical reviews for changes implemented by L1 and L2 engineers.
  • Lead complex production incidents and perform Root Cause Analysis.
  • Identify recurring issues and implement permanent automated solutions.
  • Improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational reliability.
  • Participate in architecture and technical design discussions.
  • Lead production deployments, infrastructure upgrades, patching, and maintenance activities.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to L1 and L2 engineers.
  • Create and maintain:
    • SOPs
    • Runbooks
    • Technical standards
    • Architecture documentation
    • DR documentation
    • Operational procedures

Experience

8–12 years of relevant experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or a related field is required.

Core Technical Skills

Strong hands-on expertise in:

  • AWS
  • Amazon EKS
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform
  • Terragrunt
  • AWX
  • Ansible
  • ArgoCD
  • GitOps
  • Helm
  • Docker
  • Jenkins
  • CI/CD
  • Git
  • Linux
  • Windows
  • Bash / Python
  • SSL/TLS
  • Infrastructure Automation
  • Disaster Recovery
  • Monitoring & Logging
  • Production Troubleshooting
  • Root Cause Analysis

L3 Expectations

An L3 Engineer should be capable of:

  • Leading technical activities independently
  • Owning complex Cloud and DevOps changes
  • Designing and implementing automation
  • Leading Disaster Recovery activities
  • Implementing GitOps using ArgoCD
  • Building automation using AWX/Ansible
  • Developing and reviewing Terraform code
  • Defining technical standards and best practices
  • Driving operational improvements
  • Mentoring L1/L2 engineers
  • Handling complex production incidents and RCA

The L3 engineer should move beyond routine operational support and focus on engineering, automation, standardization, reliability, and technical leadership.

About Rackspace Technology

We are the multicloud solutions experts. We combine our expertise with the world’s leading technologies — across applications, data and security — to deliver end-to-end solutions. We have a proven record of advising customers based on their business challenges, designing solutions that scale, building and managing those solutions, and optimizing returns into the future. Named a best place to work, year after year according to Fortune, Forbes and Glassdoor, we attract and develop world-class talent. Join us on our mission to embrace technology, empower customers and deliver the future.

More on Rackspace Technology

Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. Summary: Owns complex, cross-cutting statistical/ML and generative AI initiatives that solve high-impact clinical and business problems, setting technical direction for the area, mentoring data scientists, and partnering directly with clinical and business leaders.


Required Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in a STEM field, or equivalent experience.
  • 6–9 years of experience in data science, with significant project ownership.
  • 4–6 years hands-on building and productionizing ML/generative AI solutions.
  • 4–6 years hands-on experience with R, RStudio, and Shiny application development, including production-grade interactive tools.
  • 1+ year informally mentoring data scientists.

Preferred

  • Deep experience with responsible-AI evaluation in a pediatric/clinical setting.
  • Experience with fine-tuning or advanced RAG/agentic architectures.
  • Experience running analyses in an HPC or research-computing environment for large-scale or computing intensive studies.
  • Established working relationships with Research PIs, including study-design or analysis-planning input.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Advanced expertise in statistics, ML, and data mining; independently designs model architectures and evaluation frameworks.
  • Advanced expertise in R and RStudio; independently designs and architects production-grade Shiny applications.
  • Deep understanding of generative AI/LLM architecture; independently designs RAG/agentic solutions for high-stakes clinical/operational use cases.
  • Deep understanding of HPC/research-computing workflows; independently determines when compute-intensive work warrants HPC resources.
  • Independently designs bias/safety evaluation frameworks, with rigorous scrutiny for pediatric populations.
  • Mentors mid-level and junior data scientists on modeling, R/Shiny best practices, and responsible-AI practices.
  • Occasionally presents technical work to cross-functional groups of 5–10 people.

Job Functions

  • Architect and own end-to-end delivery of complex statistical/ML and generative AI initiatives spanning multiple use cases.
  • Architect and own delivery of complex Shiny applications and R-based analytical tools spanning multiple use cases.
  • Lead design reviews and set technical direction for own area; mentor junior/mid data scientists.
  • Own human-in-the-loop validation processes for high-stakes models within own domain, partnering with clinical SMEs.
  • Own bias/safety/explainability evaluation for owned AI outputs, with particular attention to pediatric-population risk.
  • Partner directly with Research PIs on study design, analysis planning, and interpretation of complex results.
  • Advise on appropriate use of HPC/research-computing resources for compute-intensive modeling work.
  • Build tools/libraries that scale data science products across multiple teams.
  • Partner directly with clinicians and business owners to define and prioritize high-impact problems.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Associate Director, Network Engineering is responsible for leading Data Center Engineering and Deployment Engineering teams that design, deploy, and support strategic infrastructure initiatives across the enterprise. This role provides leadership for engineering execution, infrastructure automation, AI-ready networking, and large-scale transformation programs while establishing engineering standards, deployment methodologies, and technical roadmaps.

The Associate Director requires a strong combination of leadership, engineering expertise, and execution capabilities to build high-performing teams and deliver scalable, resilient, and automated infrastructure solutions that support business growth and innovation.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly technical and strategic engineering leader to lead our Data Center Engineering and Deployment Engineering organizations.


As the Associate Director, Network Engineering, you will lead teams responsible for designing, deploying, and evolving modern data center network infrastructure while establishing engineering standards, deployment methodologies, automation practices, and technical direction that support long-term business objectives.


This role focuses on engineering leadership, deployment execution, automation, and technical strategy rather than day-to-day network operations, lifecycle management, or production support.


What You'll Do

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Data Center Network Engineers and Deployment Engineers.
  • Establish technical roadmaps, engineering standards, deployment methodologies, and automation strategies.
  • Build a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Own engineering execution for major infrastructure initiatives from design through deployment, production acceptance, and operational handoff.
  • Lead engineering and deployment efforts for modern data center network architectures utilizing Cisco and Arista technologies.
  • Enable AI-ready networking platforms supporting NVIDIA GPU and high-performance computing environments.
  • Establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated deployment practices as engineering standards using Azure DevOps, Terraform, Ansible, Python, Git, and related technologies.
  • Lead large-scale infrastructure transformation initiatives, including data center migrations, consolidations, merger and acquisition integrations, and subsidiary onboarding activities.
  • Drive adoption of orchestration, automation, observability, and telemetry platforms across the data center environment.
  • Partner with Cloud Engineering, Security Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Operations, and Architecture teams to deliver scalable, resilient, and highly automated solutions.
  • Provide technical oversight and strategic direction for deployment of network, security, visibility, and management platforms supporting enterprise infrastructure.
  • Manage cross-functional programs involving engineering, deployment, operations, security, architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives.



Use your skills to make an impact

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of data center network engineering experience.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience.
  • Experience leading engineering and deployment or implementation teams.
  • Demonstrated success building, mentoring, and developing high-performing technical organizations.
  • Extensive experience leading the design, deployment, and transformation of enterprise data center networks utilizing Arista EOS and Cisco Nexus platforms, VXLAN/EVPN architectures, spine-leaf networking, BGP routing, Data Center Interconnect (DCI), and Cisco-to-Arista migration programs.
  • Strong Infrastructure as Code (IaC) experience utilizing Terraform, Ansible, Python, Git, and similar automation frameworks.
  • Experience building and managing Azure DevOps (ADO) deployment pipelines and continuous integration and continuous delivery practices.
  • Experience with modern data center orchestration, automation, management, and observability platforms, including Cisco Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller (NDFC), Arista CloudVision Portal or CloudVision as a Service (CVP/CVaaS), Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Aruba Orchestrator, Gigamon visibility platforms, Arista DANZ Monitoring Fabric (DMF), or similar enterprise-scale management and telemetry solutions.
  • Experience leveraging orchestration and visibility platforms for fabric provisioning, network automation, telemetry, observability, configuration management, operational consistency, and deployment lifecycle management.
  • Experience leading large-scale data center migration, integration, and transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading engineering teams through organizational transformation, technology modernization, merger and acquisition integration efforts, or large-scale infrastructure transitions.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting NVIDIA AI networking solutions, GPU clusters, RoCE-based architectures, AI fabrics, or other high-performance computing environments.
  • Experience with Equinix and Megaport connectivity solutions.
  • Familiarity with Palo Alto Networks and Fortinet platforms.
  • General familiarity with Aruba, Cisco, and Fortinet SD-WAN technologies and their integration within enterprise network environments.
  • Experience leading large-scale infrastructure programs utilizing Agile, Scrum, PMI, PMO, or similar project and portfolio management methodologies.
  • Industry certifications such as CCIE Data Center, Arista ACE, PCNSE, Fortinet NSE, NVIDIA Networking certifications, Project Management Professional (PMP), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or equivalent credentials.


Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$142,300 - $195,700 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 10-08-2026


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

The Loss Mitigation Underwriter l will be responsible for underwriting Loan Modifications applications in accordance with Treasury, Company and Investor guidelines while following company’s policies and procedures under general supervision. Makes sound underwriting decisions and ensures that all decisions meet legal and policy requirements. Perform all duties in accordance with the company’s policies and procedures, all US state and federal laws and regulations, wherein the company operates. The Loss Mitigation Underwriter I level is the entry level role in the job family and generally handles the least complex underwriting files while gaining additional knowledge and experience on the more complex files. The target pay range for this position is $23.00 - $26.00 per hour.

What you’ll do:

  • Perform a thorough analysis to ensure the quality of each loan and to determine compliance with Treasury, Company and Investor guidelines.
  • Conduct Verification of Income (VOI).
  • Calculate customer’s front and back-end debt to income ratio.
  • Verify occupancy, hardship and income.
  • Apply payment waterfall to determine workout eligibility (repayment plan, forbearance, modification or liquidation options).
  • If applicable, identify the type(s) and amounts of liquid assets the borrower holds.
  • Determine and communicate needed conditions to properly document the file (reason for default letter, updated pay stubs, bankruptcy papers, etc.).
  • Complete system tasks as required to maintain compliance with Treasury, Company and Investor guidelines.
  • Document final decision and update system of record.

What you’ll need:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1 to 2 years of underwriting loss mitigation experience required

Company Description

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth.com and follow the company on LinkedIn, X (Twitter) and Facebook.

Profile Summary:

This is a unique opportunity to join our growing Screening and Early Detection commercial team at Guardant Health as an Inside Sales Representative. The Inside Sales Representative will play a crucial role in supporting the field-based sales organization by driving product growth through exceptional virtual customer interactions to drive early detection of Colorectal Cancer (CRC) through the utilization of the Shield™ blood test.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Business Expansion: Uncover potential new business utilizing analytical insights and successfully transition incoming leads into active ordering accounts.

  • Achieve Sales Targets: Consistently meet or exceed sales goals through virtual effective prospecting, relationship-building, and execution of national sales strategies.

  • Target and Engage Healthcare Providers: Focus on building strong relationships virtually with healthcare providers, gaining their commitment to adopt the Shield test for CRC and other cancers

  • Challenger Selling: Engage healthcare providers virtually to understand their needs and demonstrate how Guardant Health’s offerings can improve patient outcomes and streamline their practice.

  • Resource Utilization: Utilize data from a range of internal resources (Salesforce, Veeva, competitive market data, etc…) to understand the evolving market of CRC treatments and to make data-driven decisions to support the successful execution of your business plan

  • Educate and Support Providers: Provide in-depth product knowledge and training virtually to primary care practices to gain all stakeholder support, beyond the provider, ensuring smooth integration of Shield into their workflow.

  • Provide High-Touch Customer Service: Maintain exceptional customer service standards by resolving issues proactively and supporting healthcare providers in every phase of the sales process.

  • Compliance & Administrative Excellence: Ensure adherence to company policies, industry standards, and regulations, while managing multiple projects and deadlines effectively.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum 1-year sales experience (internships, inside sales) with sales goals. This is an inside sales role so virtual selling experience in inside sales is highly preferred.

  • Education: College degree, preferred but not required.

  • Sales Expertise (Preferred): Demonstrated virtual ability to engage in selling conversations, overcoming objections and aligning client needs with product offerings.

  • Product Knowledge: Ability to quickly learn and apply technical product knowledge to drive sales.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional oral and written communication skills with the ability to present complex information in an easily understandable manner virtually.

  • CRM Proficiency (Preferred): Experience with CRM systems such as Salesforce, Veeva, or similar platforms for tracking customer interactions and sales progress.

  • Customer Service Excellence: Superior negotiation, problem-solving, and customer service skills. Preferred: High-touch customer service and relationship-building skills, with a focus on long-term partnership and success.

Personal Competencies & Attributes:

  • At Guardant Health, we value personal traits that drive success in this dynamic and impactful role. The ideal candidate will demonstrate the following core competencies:

  • Grit (Tenacity, Resilience, Scrappy): You are tenacious and resilient, able to navigate challenges with persistence and adaptability. You approach obstacles with a "scrappy" mindset, using creative solutions to keep moving forward and meet your objectives.

  • Track Record of Success / Achievement Drive: You have consistently met and exceeded goals. You are results-driven, thriving on achievement and maintaining a proven track record of success in educational pursuits, athletic or interest pursuits, or building strong relationships in the workplace through customers and cross-functional partners.

  • Initiative into Action / Problem Solver: You take initiative and make things happen. When challenges arise, you are quick to take action and find effective solutions, demonstrating your ability to problem-solve and adapt to changing circumstances.

  • Strategic Thinking & Prioritization: You excel at developing strategic plans to drive business outcomes. You are adept at prioritizing tasks, managing multiple competing demands, and staying focused on what will yield the greatest impact for the business.

  • Coachable / Growth Mindset: You have a growth mindset, viewing feedback as an opportunity for continuous improvement. You are coachable, eager to learn, and open to new ideas, always striving to develop both personally and professionally.

Personal Requirements:

  • Valid Driver’s License: A clean driving record is required for daily field office and customer visits, if required.

  • Travel Flexibility: Flexibility to travel to open territories, when needed, and occasional national travel for sales meetings.


AI & Digital Fluency

  • Demonstrate curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to critically evaluate and responsibly leverage AI-enabled tools in accordance with company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements to improve the efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of work.

Hybrid Work Model:This section is applicable to onsite employees who are eligible for hybrid work location as specified by management and related policies. Guardant has defined days for in-person/onsite collaboration and work-from-home days for individual-focused time. All U.S. employees who live within 50 miles of a Guardant facility will be required to be onsite on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. We have found aligning our scheduled in-office days allows our teams to do the best work and creates the focused thinking time our innovative work requires. At Guardant, our work model has created flexibility for better work-life balance while keeping teams connected to advance our science for our patients.

Employee may be required to lift routine office supplies and use office equipment. Majority of the work is performed in a desk/office environment; however, there may be exposure to high noise levels, fumes, and biohazard material in the laboratory environment. Ability to sit for extended periods of time.

The Manager, Provider Performance Engagement is accountable for overseeing the performance engagement activities with internal and external partners. With a focus on improving health outcomes and total cost of care, the manager, Provider Performance Engagement closely aligns Provider interventions with customized APM engagement plans, oversees implementation, assesses results, and lends guidance for improvement opportunities.

Essential Functions:

  • Conduct internal and external meetings to establish and execute on detailed provider performance engagement plans for new and existing providers
  • Manage customized provider plans to support key quality metrics to ensure positive outcomes.
  • Manage process development activities for provider onboarding and oversight
  • Ensure compliance with state, federal and regulatory body requirements
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of departmental policies and procedures for oversight of contracted providers in an Alternative Payment Model (APM)
  • Analyze, update, and modify procedures to continually improve engagement processes
  • Review and incorporate data analysis for program metrics, outcome measures and results, and savings opportunities
  • Support and manage financial ROI, quality metrics, and service level agreements to evaluate success of provider engagement initiatives
  • Identify and manage risk associated with any process change, implement mitigation strategies & communicate/escalate to stakeholders
  • Report provider APM program progress and oversight status to all stakeholders
  • Ensure provider performance engagement milestone deliverables are completed for each project phase
  • Maintain internal strategic alignment when prioritizing projects by following established RACI document to ensure appropriate engagement for stakeholders,
  • Participate in Provider Oversight Committee meetings with internal business owners and providers
  • Provide leadership guidance to ensure staff career growth
  • Oversee day-to-day activities of staff to ensure department goals are achieved
  • Strategically manage department staff objectives and prioritization to ensure alignment with market and corporate goals
  • Perform any other job-related instructions as requested

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience is required
  • Master’s degree in business or health related field is preferred
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience working collaboratively with external Health Partners is required
  • Familiarity of the healthcare field and experience with payer-provider integration is required
  • Minimum of one (1) year leadership/management experience preferred

Competencies, Knowledge and Skills:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office tools, including Project, Word, and Excel
  • Thorough understanding of project management processes, techniques and tools
  • In-depth knowledge of regulatory and quality standards and measures including but not limited to State Medicaid programs, Medicare and Quality Accreditation (e.g., ODM, CMS, NCQA, URAC, etc.)

  • Ability to communicate before individuals, groups, and executive leadership

Yugo is the trusted name for student housing, globally. Every day we connect young people to opportunities and students to amazing spaces. Here at Yugo, we like to do things differently. It's about people, planet, and passion.

As a Business Development Executive, you will be Yugo’s on-the-ground presence across continental Northern Europe (France, Austria, Germany and Poland), generating and nurturing leads, and supporting underwriting and tender processes with local market insight. You will act as a cultural and language reference point for the region, building relationships and representing Yugo in-market. Commercial structuring and negotiation for opportunities you generate is currently led by the Head of Business Development, Europe, to whom this role reports, while the team scales. This is a fantastic opportunity for an ambitious, culturally fluent self-starter to build a career in commercial business development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate new business leads across continental Northern Europe (France, Austria, Germany and Poland) through research, outreach and market mapping.
  • Act as Yugo’s on-the-ground presence in-market, building relationships with developers, agents and local stakeholders.
  • Serve as a cultural and language reference point for the region, helping the wider team navigate local nuance and relationships.
  • Qualify and nurture leads through the early stages of the pipeline, maintaining regular contact until opportunities are ready for commercial engagement.
  • Support underwriting of new opportunities with local market insight, site data and market comparables.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all deals, contacts, leads and company information in HubSpot, keeping the pipeline current and reliable for the wider team.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify new opportunities across the region.
  • Organise and support local meetings, site visits and introductions, building Yugo’s profile in-market.
  • Support tenders, RFP responses and proposal development with local market knowledge and language support.
  • Represent Yugo at industry events and networking opportunities as required, supporting lead generation and brand visibility.
  • Liaise with internal teams (operations, finance, legal) to support the smooth progression of opportunities from initial enquiry to handover.
  • Feed local market intelligence back to the Head of Business Development and wider team to inform commercial strategy.
  • Support post-deal handover to the operations team, helping ensure a smooth transition from signed agreement to mobilisation.
  • Monitor industry trends and market activity across the region to help identify new business opportunities.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Support the Head of Business Development in maintaining relationships with existing introducers, agents and partners across the region.
  • Help monitor and track the performance of live opportunities, flagging risks or delays to the wider team.
  • Assist with onboarding new opportunities into operational delivery once contracts are signed.
  • Support continuous improvement of business development processes, tools and reporting.
  • Build a strong working knowledge of Yugo’s existing continental European accounts to support the wider team where needed.

What else?

This job description serves as a guideline, this list of responsibilities is not intended to be exhaustive and other requests commensurate with the role may be made of you from time-to-time. This is a hands-on, fast-paced support role.

Requirements

  • Some experience in business development, sales, real estate or property management is beneficial; student accommodation or PBSA experience is a plus but not essential.
  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Confident communicator, comfortable engaging with prospective clients and internal stakeholders across different cultures and languages.
  • Confident in building, nurturing and progressing relationships, across both short-term and long-term deal generation.
  • Financially numerate, with an interest in developing commercial and underwriting skills.
  • Common sense in commercial negotiations.
  • A proactive self-starter, comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in English plus at least one additional language relevant to the region (e.g. German, French or Polish) — genuine local and cultural fluency is central to this role.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (particularly Excel and PowerPoint) and comfortable learning CRM systems.
  • A genuine interest in the student housing / PBSA sector and a desire to build a career in commercial business development.
  • Willingness to travel regularly across continental Northern Europe.
  • An aptitude for AI as we continue to bring efficiencies to our business, freeing up more time to build relationships.

About Us

At Rocket SaaS, we’re redefining what a B2B marketing agency should be. We partner with ambitious SaaS companies as an extension of their team, building end-to-end demand generation strategies that drive predictable growth. We value curiosity over convention, ownership over process, and collaboration over silos. Nothing is off the table if it helps our clients grow. You’ll have the freedom to test ideas, shape strategy and work alongside talented specialists who genuinely care about doing great work.

Since launching, we’ve become one of the UK’s fastest-growing SaaS marketing agencies. We’ve grown organically through client referrals, long-term partnerships and a reputation for delivering measurable results.

If you’re looking for a role where your ideas will shape strategy, your work will have a measurable impact, and you’ll help shape the growth of some of the most exciting SaaS companies, we’d love to hear from you.

The Role

We’re looking for a Marketing Manager with experience project-managing and executing successful marketing strategies in a fast-paced environment. You will be responsible for a broad range of activity for multiple SaaS clients, including, but not limited to: crafting compelling content, managing social campaigns, communicating with senior stakeholders, running email marketing campaigns and project management in Asana. This role reports into a Marketing Account Director, who you’ll work closely to create bespoke campaigns and strategies. There will be a mixture of hands-on work and collaboration with a team of in-house and external resources. This role offers clear progression into either a Senior Marketing Manager position or a Marketing Account Director role, where you’ll take full ownership of campaign strategy and delivery.

What you will do:

  • Run market research and competitor analysis for our clients, digging into their market and competitors’ messaging

  • Help define each client’s ideal customer profile, building a clear picture of who we are targeting and why

  • Work alongside your Marketing Account Director to shape client strategy: you will contribute ideas, own your pieces of the plan and see how senior strategists think up close

  • Craft short and long-form content, including email campaigns, social posts, video, blogs, landing pages and thought-leadership, keeping every piece on-message and on-deadline

  • Write clear creative briefs for landing pages and ads, and work with our Design Team through feedback rounds to get them right

  • Partner with our Development Team to deliver landing pages and get websites built, tested and live

  • Keeping all projects on track and highly organised, you're the one who always knows what's due, what's blocked, and what's next

  • Managing regular internal and client meetings: Help run internal and client meetings by preparing agendas, capturing actions, and making sure follow-ups actually happen

Key skills/experience:

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, confidently managing multiple projects and priorities without compromising quality.

  • You are highly organised and dependable, consistently meeting deadlines and helping keep projects and teammates on track.

  • You are a collaborative team player, happy to roll up your sleeves, take ownership, and support colleagues wherever needed.

  • You are proactive and eager to learn, quickly picking up new skills, tools, and ways of working.

  • You are passionate about B2B marketing, with a genuine ambition to build a long-term career and become an expert in your field.

  • You have a growth mindset, actively seeking feedback and continuously looking for ways to improve both your own performance and client outcomes.

Why you’ll love it at Rocket SaaS 🚀

  • Work your way: Fully remote within South Africa

  • Real career growth: we're on a mission to scale, and we promote from within

  • Real impact: your strategies directly shape the growth of ambitious SaaS brands

  • A culture people enjoy being part of: quarterly staff parties and a monthly team quiz with cash prizes

Ready to join?

If you are ready to work with a forward-looking, progressive company that values creativity, collaboration, and growth, we'd love to hear from you.
