We provide a mission-critical DevOps and Data Management platform purpose-built for the Salesforce ecosystem. Our suite of products—including CI/CD, automated testing, backup & recovery, and data masking—empowers organizations to release code faster, more securely, and with total data integrity. We are entering a phase of hyper-growth and are looking for a foundational leader to build our Enterprise presence in the United States.

The Role

Director of Enterprise Sales to serve as the "Incubator" for our U.S. sales organization. This is a unique "zero-to-one" opportunity. You will not be an armchair manager; you will be a hands-on builder responsible for the entire end-to-end operation of this business unit—from pipeline generation and prospecting to closing high-value deals.

You will begin by personally leading and scaling an initial "pod" of 8 to 10 representatives. Once you have identified, tested, and nailed the repeatable processes, you will rapidly scale the organization to a team of 40+ remote representatives across the U.S., hiring and mentoring a layer of Sales Managers to support this growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Incubation: Design, implement, and document the end-to-end sales process for the Enterprise segment.
  • Full-Cycle Ownership: Drive the entire revenue engine, including outbound prospecting strategies, pipeline development, and closing.
  • Hands-on Leadership: Act as a player-coach, joining discovery calls and demos to ensure the business is rock-solid at the 10-rep level before scaling.
  • Rapid Scaling: Lead the aggressive expansion from 10 to 40+ remote reps, identifying and hiring internal Managers as the team grows.
  • Data-Driven Operations: Establish KPIs and a rigorous, data-backed forecasting model to ensure predictable revenue growth.
  • Messaging & Positioning: Master the technical value proposition of our DevOps and Data security tools, coaching the team on how to move from "feature selling" to "value selling."
  • Culture Building: Create a high-performance, accountable, and transparent culture within a 100% remote workforce.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Proven Track Record: 8+ years of B2B SaaS sales leadership experience, with a documented history of building teams from the ground up.
  • Ecosystem Expertise: Deep familiarity with the Salesforce ecosystem or DevOps/Data Management industries is highly preferred.
  • The "Builder" DNA: You must be a hands-on problem solver who prefers "doing the work" over high-level observation.
  • Scaling Experience: Proven ability to manage a remote organization of 30+ people and a history of developing "leaders of leaders."
  • Operational Excellence: Expert-level understanding of CRM hygiene, sales stack optimization, and outbound prospecting methodologies.
  • Residing in the USA: This role is remote but requires residency in the United States to manage the domestic market.

Why join us?

  • Autonomy: You own the Enterprise P&L and have the authority to build the team in your image.
  • Impact: Your processes will become the blueprint for our global expansion.
  • Complexity: Work with a sophisticated, technical product suite that solves real-world engineering and security challenges.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to shape the digital strategy at a high-growth Salesforce ISV.
  • Collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • Career growth in a fast-scaling company serving global enterprises.

Extras (Benefits & Perks)

  • Competitive compensation, incentive structure, and company equity
  • Daily coaching, mentorship, and growth opportunity
  • Be part of a global, mission-driven team
  • Learn from top leaders in Salesforce DevOps and SaaS sales
  • Work on exciting challenges in a rapidly growing industry

Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience.   • Build a sustainable pipeline of enterprise opportunities.

  • Maintain strong CRM discipline and reporting.

  • Work globally across BSI teams to accelerate growth.

What we’re looking for

Essential

  • Proven enterprise business development or strategic sales experience.

  • Strong track record winning new business and creating pipeline.

  • Experience selling complex solutions into large organisations.

  • Ability to engage senior technology and business stakeholders.

  • Strong commercial awareness and consultative selling capability.

  • Experience navigating complex global organisations.

  • Highly self-motivated with a hunter mindset and passion for growth.

Highly desirable

  • Experience working with or selling into the Technology, Telecommunications, Software, Digital Services or ICT sector.

  • Understanding of areas such as cyber security, digital trust, operational resilience, governance, risk or compliance.

  • Experience selling consulting, advisory, assurance or certification services.

  • Existing senior relationships within enterprise technology organisations.

Salary Range:

US = $102,000 - $127,500 + Commission

The advertised salary range reflects the level, scope and responsibilities of the role. Starting salary within that range will be determined based on experience, skills, market considerations and alignment with internal equity principles.

Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

If you want to contribute to this inspiring challenge, bring your open and enthusiastic mindset to our dynamic team, apply now and become part of the BSI family!

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

About Us

BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.

Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.

SummaryWhy should you join the BlueCross BlueShield of South Carolina family of companies? Other companies come and go, but we've been part of the national landscape for more than seven decades, with our roots firmly embedded in the South Carolina community. We are the largest insurance company in South Carolina … and much more. We are one of the nation's leading administrators of government contracts. We operate one of the most sophisticated data processing centers in the Southeast. We also have a diverse family of subsidiary companies, allowing us to build on various business strengths. We deliver outstanding service to our customers. If you are dedicated to the same philosophy, consider joining our team!

We are currently hiring for an RN Concierge Care Manager to join BlueCross BlueShield of South Carolina. In this role as an RN Concierge Care Manager, you will provide care management services to more than 2 million members in South Carolina and nationally, administer complex, high-touch concierge case management for members identified into specialized programs such as high-risk maternity, NICU, ESRD, Cancer, Palliative Care or Behavioral Health, identify risks and provides outreach services to facilitate the coordination of healthcare services and gap closure, and provide individualized care plans to ensure cost-effectiveness, overall care satisfaction, and improved quality of life.


Description

Location

This position is full-time (40 hours/week) Monday-Friday from 8:00am-5:00pm EST and will be fully remote. The candidate will be required to work two evenings a month to 8:00pm. To work from home, the candidate must have high-speed (non-satellite) internet and a private, secure home office.

Sponsorship: This position is not eligible for sponsorship now or in the future.

The position will be fully remote on a desktop computer to provide highly interactive case management to assigned members. Members will include those with chronic or high-risk conditions and those who are admitted to inpatient care. You will educate and guide members through prior authorizations and understanding the need to adhere to medications and the plan of care. Most interactions will be by phone and through our messaging system, perfect for those who love case management and improving the lives and medical outcomes of members while working in your own home office.

To aid in your consideration, please attach a copy of your current RN license, orinclude your RN license number on your resume.

What You’ll Do:

  • Directs day-to-day, high-touch member management to include implementation of program goals, coordination of treatment plans and benefit coordination for high-risk patient populations and/or those with complex conditions.
  • Coordinates clinical services with external sources to include: providers, vendors, facilities, social workers/case managers and/or community services.
  • Participates in team training and continuing medical education.
  • Prepares for external audits and quality assurance efforts.

raw.excerpt: We’re VaynerMedia!  We are a contemporary global creative and media agency built for the now.
raw.description:
We’re VaynerMedia! We are a contemporary global creative and media agency built for the now. Born in social, our work is now full service, simply loving big ideas that connect and create real change for our clients business. We are independently owned, founded in 2009 with offices in London, Amsterdam, New York, Los Angeles, Singapore, Tokyo, Sydney, Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Mexico City. We are recognized for our work in Cannes Lions, the Clios, D&AD and The Webbies to name a few.

Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it. VaynerMedia EMEA is strong with a world-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time – PEOPLE. Day in and day out, we propel some of the biggest brands in the world to the intersection of attention and culture. In EMEA, we are proudly 250+, servicing multi-brands across the region.

The PITCH.

We are creators, creative industry rogues and stars. We are not just on the internet; we are creating the stuff the internet and the world wants to see. We’re curious, hungry and passionate about what we do - and the people we do it with. We move so fast and make so much good stuff it's tough to keep up with. And we need more folks just like us, the unconventional, less-obvious, unseasoned (or over seasoned) creative pros. But above all - passionate makers and culture shakers.

Want in? We love subversive artists, obsessive makers, dedicated creators and we don’t care if you're a baby fresh to the workforce or working on your third act. What’s your hustle? Documentarian? DJ? Sports junkie? Fashionista? Blogger? Vlogger? Retired logger? Are you an Insta-fiend? An unabashed TikTokker? Or both? We’re down with all of that. Just as long as you love making and are really good at it.

Here’s where you come in…

  • Ideate and conceptualise high-engaging thinking that reflects brand's aesthetic and style guidelines; maintaining aesthetic, tone, and brand consistency across all deliverables across a variety of clients and industries
  • Manage multiple projects with varying deadlines simultaneously.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (creative, client services, and strategy) to develop the best possible creative ideas that hits all criteria (client briefs, feedback, client KPIs)
  • Write and edit copy for social content and campaigns, including, but not limited to Campaign Ideas, Campaign Manifestos, TVC & Video Scripts, Brand Identity Decks (Social Voice), Brand Manifestos
  • Consistently produce ideas and campaigns with impact on brief, on time and across any media without constant oversight
  • Collaborate cross-departmentally to develop a high variety of ideas that meets creative and strategic criteria (client briefs, feedback, client KPIs)
  • Gather learnings and insights to make relevant recommendations to keep improving and making better work.
  • Able to present with growing confidence to your team, senior clients, new biz, to agency and creative leaders
  • Mentors juniors as a proficient doer when working within our dynamic brand team structure
  • Working with Lead Creator and with support of Project management and Client partners

We treasure Personality and Experience yet we do know that these qualifications lead to what WE KNOW as a success:

  • 4-6 years professional creative experience, with a demonstrable passion for making creative content.
  • Significant advertising experience in agency or similar environments, developing and creating TTL, digital and platform specific social campaigns.
  • Impressive portfolio exemplifying previous success with proven ability to develop creative concepts, copy and design from social to TVC.
  • Advanced experience in adobe packages and able to execute, as well as conceptualize (ideation and creation)
  • Proficiency in deck creation (ideally in the Google suite) with the ability to convey ideas in the best way possible.
  • Strong passion to all things social, digital and creative, with a keen interest in new platforms, technologies and innovation across our industry and the creative landscape
  • Advanced interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with the wider team during pitches and presentations
  • A knack for picking up different editorial voices, understanding why they work, and switching between them quickly
  • Ability to produce work to a high standard quickly and professionally with attention to detail
  • Strong sense of responsibility and ownership, and a commitment to delivering best practice and value
  • Deep vocabulary, working knowledge of slang terms and colloquial expressions
  • Cool, calm and collaborative when working under pressure along with the ability to anticipate and solve problems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German

Here’s how we support you…

  • Unlimited Holiday + 1 Day Birthday Leave
  • Journey EAP - proactive and crisis support with life concierge services
  • Once you reach 2 years round the Vayner sun, you’re eligible for an annual €150 budget to spend on anything that you’re curious about
  • A flexible co-working space for any remote employees wanting to access an office space, and / or for team collaboration days
  • €200 towards a home working allowance (ADD THIS IF ROLE IS REMOTE)
  • Kick start your mental & physical fitness with 15% extra credits and €30 off a monthly membership with ClassPass.

What you SHOULD KNOW about VaynerMedia

Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!

We believe 100% that brands can be built on digital platforms and part of our model is built bottom up, flipping the traditional advertising model and process on its head. We don’t play to agency/industry norms and our culture and energy reflects that.

Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us. We can’t wait to meet you.

VaynerMedia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This means that VaynerMedia provides equal employment opportunities to all staff members and job applicants without regard to gender, pregnancy, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, disability, sexual orientation, religious belief, part time or fixed term employment, age or any other legally protected class.

Candidates must be authorised to work in Germany.

raw.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Communications/Documentation Specialist supporting the Peraton Program Management Office (PMO).

Position Overview

The Program Communications & Documentation Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring the clarity, consistency, and quality of organizational communications and technical content. This individual is a skilled writer and editor who thrives in a fast-paced environment, manages multiple priorities with precision, and serves as a central resource for documentation, communications, and administrative support. The ideal candidate brings exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational instincts, and the ability to translate complex technical information into clear, audience-appropriate content.

This position is a mix of technical writing, communications, and documentation librarian. Candidates with experience in technical writing/formatting, developing communications along with SharePoint administration are highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Writing & Documentation

  • Edit and maintain a broad range of technical and programmatic documents, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), program reports, and reference guides.
  • Ensure all documentation adheres to established style guides, grammar standards, and organizational formatting requirements.
  • Manage the full document lifecycle — from initial drafting through review, revision, approval, and version control.
  • Coordinate documentation review cycles with internal technical teams and external stakeholders, tracking feedback, consolidating comments, and ensuring timely resolution and final approval.

Communications Support

  • Draft, edit, and refine internal and external communications, including executive correspondence, announcements, newsletters, and stakeholder updates.
  • Tailor written content to diverse audiences, adjusting tone, format, and level of detail as appropriate for executive, technical, or general readership.
  • Proofread all outgoing communications to ensure accuracy, professionalism, and adherence to organizational voice and standards.

SharePoint Administration & Organization

  • Serve as a primary administrator of the organization's SharePoint environment, ensuring sites, libraries, and pages are well-structured, up to date, and accessible to the appropriate audiences.
  • Support and maintain intuitive SharePoint site architecture, including document libraries, folder hierarchies, metadata tagging, and permission management to support efficient information retrieval and collaboration.
  • Develop and enforce SharePoint governance standards, including naming conventions, version control protocols, and content lifecycle management.
  • Collaborate with IT and program teams to implement SharePoint enhancements, integrate workflows, and troubleshoot access or content issues as they arise.

Task & Administrative Management

  • Maintain organized tracking systems for open action items, document reviews, deadlines, and miscellaneous tasks — ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Support ad-hoc administrative tasks as needed, including scheduling, meeting minutes, and coordination of cross-functional activities.
  • Proactively follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and deliverables.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 2 years with BS/BA; 6 years with a HS diploma/equivalent
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in technical writing, documentation management, or a related communications role.
  • Demonstrated expertise in grammar, punctuation, style, and document formatting.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and deadlines with a high degree of organization and attention to detail.
  • Experience coordinating document reviews with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook) and document management tools.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels of an organization.
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required agency clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting federal government programs or working within a regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with IT, infrastructure, or technology program documentation.
  • Experience with Microsoft SharePoint Online including site creation, document library management, permissions configuration, and content organization and SharePoint integration with Microsoft 365 tools (Teams, OneDrive, Power Automate).
  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility standards for documents, presentations, and SharePoint content.

Target Salary Range

$66,000 - $106,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results. On every deal that means minimising attrition, locking in the best terms, spotting growth opportunities, feeding insights back to the business and closing 36-month renewals.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You enjoy working at high velocity:
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Own 60+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end and exceed sales targets
  • Follow a structured scenario-based forecasting methodology
  • Engage with customers to identify and mitigate renewal risk and drive platform adoption at scale
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams to solve problems and ensure a successful, smooth renewal
  • Contribute to an exceptional team environment that motivates the team to perform at its best
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in German (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years of full-cycle closing sales experience, ideally with mid-sized businesses in a high-transaction environment.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • Empathy for customers and teammates, and strong organisation.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

This is a remote role open to candidates in the contiguous 48 US states, with travel 4–6 times a year to Middle Tennessee for team meetings or to other Lifeway events.

Why Lifeway?

Lifeway is a place where you can bring your faith and work experience to join in the most important mission in the world: making disciples of Jesus Christ. Whether you’re a creator or storyteller, data guru or problem-solver, or anywhere in between, if you’re passionate about serving the church, we have a place for you. Lifeway has a strong Work from Anywhere (WFA) culture that is deeply focused on our mission and values. While headquartered in Nashville, TN, many of our positions are remote-eligible and have autonomy and flexibility with work hours. We provide equipment and resources to ensure team members have access to a productive workspace. We believe building relationships and community is essential to how we work together, so Lifeway hosts all-team meetings several times per year and provides travel for key team gatherings for remote-based team members. Full-time employees are eligible for enrollment in our comprehensive benefits plans including healthcare, vacation and sick time, holiday pay, care days, 401(k) plan, maternity and parental leave, adoption assistance, mission trip time, and more. If this sounds like a place where you would be excited to serve the kingdom of God, we would love for you to join our team.

Learn more about our culture at team.lifeway.com/culture-code

This is a remote position in the U.S. with occasional travel to Nashville for in-person team gatherings.

raw.description:
We Do Consulting Differently


Job Summary


The Cybersecurity Analyst supports BRG’s daily security operations across cloud, identity, email, data, and endpoint environments. The analyst monitors and investigates security events, supports security platform and policy administration, coordinates remediation, and contributes to security baselines and control improvements. The analyst works closely with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Network, Service Desk, Risk and Compliance, and external security partners to protect BRG resources and support a Zero Trust approach. This position does not own or administer corporate firewalls.


Key Contacts and Working Relationships

  • Partner with IT Leadership and technical teams to ensure new technologies, configurations, and changes align with BRG security standards and roadmaps.
  • Work with Infrastructure, Network, Service Desk, Expert Solutions, and Corporate Information Services teams to investigate issues and apply security controls across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Coordinate with Risk and Compliance on incident response, audit evidence, security awareness, and control validation.
  • Work with BRG’s managed security and technology vendors to investigate alerts, track remediation, and improve platform effectiveness.

Major Responsibilities / Job Functions

  • Monitor, triage, investigate, document, and coordinate response to security alerts, incidents, tickets, and suspicious activity across Microsoft and third-party security platforms.
  • Work with BRG’s managed security provider to investigate alerts, validate activity, track remediation, and improve alert quality and operational workflows.
  • Administer and support Microsoft security capabilities across Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft Defender, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, and Microsoft Purview within approved role and change-control boundaries.
  • Review Azure security recommendations, policies, and configuration findings; help test, document, and implement Azure Policy initiatives, security baselines, and control exceptions.
  • Support identity security operations, including Conditional Access, privileged access and PIM reviews, role lifecycle activities, stale-account cleanup, authentication controls, service accounts, guest access, and privileged-group monitoring.
  • Support Proofpoint email security, phishing-reporting workflows, Threat Response capabilities, account-takeover protections, security-awareness integrations, and email-policy tuning.
  • Use Tenable Cloud Security and related vulnerability-management capabilities to review cloud exposure, attack paths, asset coverage, security findings, and remediation status.
  • Support Netskope cloud-app and traffic-steering policies, including application discovery, policy testing, AI-application controls, exception handling, and validation of user impact.
  • Assess security risks associated with generative AI and other AI-enabled services; support AI application inventory, usage monitoring, access controls, policy testing, and governance reviews.
  • Investigate email, identity, endpoint, cloud, and application activity using available logs and evidence; escalate confirmed or potentially significant events through the incident-response process.
  • Track vulnerabilities and security recommendations, identify the appropriate technical owner, validate remediation evidence, document accepted risks or exceptions, and report status to stakeholders.
  • Create and maintain operating procedures, configuration records, support documentation, security metrics, dashboards, and evidence needed for audits and control reviews.
  • Participate in change reviews and validate that cybersecurity-owned changes include appropriate testing, implementation, rollback, communication, and post-change evidence.
  • Evaluate security tools and features, perform structured testing, document findings, and recommend practical improvements to security controls and operations.
  • Participate in periodic risk assessments, tabletop exercises, incident-response activities, cross-training, and an on-call or escalation rotation as required.

Knowledge, Skills and Behaviors

  • 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, cloud security, identity security, security engineering, or a closely related role.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure security, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure Policy, Conditional Access, PIM, Defender, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, and Purview.
  • Experience interpreting and applying security baselines such as Microsoft security baselines and CIS Benchmarks, including testing, exception documentation, and remediation tracking.
  • Hands-on familiarity with email security and phishing-response workflows; Proofpoint experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with cloud security posture management or CNAPP capabilities; Tenable Cloud Security experience is preferred.
  • Experience with secure web gateway, cloud access security broker, or SaaS application-control platforms; Netskope policy and traffic-steering experience is preferred.
  • General knowledge of AI security risks, including sensitive-data exposure, unapproved AI services, prompt and response monitoring limitations, application categorization, access control, and governance.
  • Understanding of common identity and authentication concepts, including MFA, passwordless authentication, OAuth, SAML, Kerberos, privileged access, and least privilege.
  • Ability to analyze alerts and logs, distinguish expected administration from suspicious activity, develop a defensible timeline, and clearly document conclusions and follow-up actions.
  • Experience working with a SOC, MDR provider, or other outsourced monitoring partner.
  • Familiarity with Windows, macOS, cloud platforms, enterprise SaaS, and hybrid identity environments.
  • Knowledge of common security and compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, SOC 2, ISO 27001/27002, HIPAA, or HITRUST.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain risk, evidence, and recommended actions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Organized, curious, and able to manage multiple investigations and workstreams while maintaining accurate records and following change-management requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting security operations in a Microsoft-centric enterprise environment.
  • Experience creating KQL queries, workbooks, metrics, or dashboards for security monitoring and reporting.
  • Experience testing security controls in pilot groups before broader rollout and documenting expected impact, exceptions, and rollback considerations.
  • Relevant security certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200), CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, GIAC certifications, or comparable credentials are preferred. Equivalent hands-on security operations experience will also be considered.

Salary Range: $90,000-$120,000


Candidate must be able to submit verification of his/her legal right to work in the U.S., without company sponsorship.




About BRG

BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead.

At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe.

Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world.

At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen.


BRG is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our hiring practices provide equal opportunity for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender, national origin, age, United States military veteran status, ancestry, sexual orientation, marital status, family structure, medical condition including genetic characteristics or information, veteran status, or mental or physical disability so long as the essential functions of the job can be performed with or without reasonable accommodation, or any other protected category under federal, state, or local law.

Job Title: Director, Channel Partner Sales

Department: Business Development

Work Location: US-Remote

About Genea

As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We’re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of teamwork, transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don’t take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace in 2021-2026, with a rating of 4.4 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor. Our team members love our competitive benefits, including 401k matching, PTO, 100% paid parental leave, remote work options, and development/training opportunities.

Job Overview

Genea is creating this role to bring our enterprise security channel sales and partner organization under a single leader. The Director, Channel Partner Sales owns revenue delivered through the channel and leads a team of approximately twelve, including senior regional sales managers, regional sales managers, and sales engineers.

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer and serving on the go-to-market leadership team, this role sets channel strategy and builds the systems, metrics, and talent to execute it. The work is programmatic: designing repeatable motions, deepening partner relationships, and using data and AI to make the team more effective.

Because the role is new, the person in this seat will continue to define and refine how Genea sells through partners, working closely with the CEO and with real influence over company strategy.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own new business revenue delivered through the enterprise security channel, including pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and quarterly attainment.
  • Lead senior regional sales managers, regional sales managers, and sales engineers against a single channel strategy and set of priorities.
  • Recruit, enable, and grow channel partners, building the partner base into a durable and predictable source of revenue.
  • Design repeatable sales motions, including segmentation, territory design, playbooks, and stage definitions, that scale beyond individual performers.
  • Establish the metrics, dashboards, and forecast discipline the go-to-market leadership team relies on to make decisions.
  • Define how sales engineering supports the channel, from partner technical enablement through opportunity-level support.
  • Apply AI tools to research, prospecting, partner planning, and forecasting, and set the standard for how the team uses them.
  • Hire, develop, and retain sales talent; set performance expectations and coach managers and individual contributors against them.
  • Partner with marketing, product, and customer success to align messaging, pricing, and roadmap input with what partners and end customers need.
  • Represent Genea with senior stakeholders at partner firms and end customers, including at industry events.

Qualifications

Experience — Required

  • 8–10+ years in B2B sales or business development, including at least three years leading and developing sales teams.
  • Channel or partner sales experience: recruiting, enabling, and managing external partners as a durable source of revenue.
  • Demonstrated record of building repeatable, programmatic sales processes rather than relying on individual performance.
  • Experience carrying and delivering against a revenue number, with accountability for forecast accuracy.
  • Experience building or scaling a sales function, including hiring and developing employees.

Experience — Preferred

  • Selling physical security or property technology through a partner channel.
  • Leading or working alongside sales engineering in a technical, solution-based sales environment.

Technical Skills — Required

  • Proficiency with CRM and reporting tools; able to build and interpret pipeline and forecast dashboards without support.
  • Practical experience applying AI tools to go-to-market work, and judgment about where they help and where they do not.
  • Strong quantitative skills; comfortable working directly with data to diagnose performance and set targets.

Additional Skills — Required

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present credibly to executive and partner audiences.
  • Willing and able to travel for customer, partner, and industry events.

Compensation and Benefits

Compensation: $200,000 annual base salary / $275,000 OTE

On-target earnings reflect base salary plus variable sales compensation.

This range reflects what Genea reasonably expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Where an offer falls within the range depends on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills, and on internal equity.

Benefits

Full-time employees are eligible to participate in a comprehensive benefits program that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts (FSA); life insurance; accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance; long-term disability (LTD) coverage; paid time off (PTO); and a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Eligibility is subject to plan terms and conditions.

E-Verify

Genea participates in E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all new hires working in the United States. For more information about E-Verify, please visit the E-Verify website.

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

About Sargent & Lundy

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

The total compensation package for eligible positions will include a base salary or an hourly rate and a comprehensive benefits package, reflecting our commitment to rewarding performance and supporting the overall well-being of our employees. Individuals may also be eligible to participate in our yearly discretionary bonus.

About This Business Unit

Sargent & Lundy’s Government Services Division provides cutting-edge engineering design and consulting support to the management and operating contractors for US Department of Energy (DOE) sites and national laboratories. Specifically, we support the DOE Environmental Management Directorate as well as the National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) laboratories and sites. What does this mean? You can be a part of multi-discipline design teams supporting projects cleaning up the environmental damage associated with the legacy nuclear weapons production complex and/or preserving our country’s nuclear deterrent. Sargent & Lundy’s personnel design facilities, systems, and equipment that treat, store, and dispose of nuclear waste as well as systems that safely handle and process nuclear material. This mission-critical work is meaningful and challenging–work you can be proud of.

Overview

RealPage Smart Building enables access to spaces, services and experiences to enhance the way we live, work and connect. We do this by unifying software, products and services into a holistic platform that delivers operational efficiency and resident value.

The Project Manager III is an experienced, revenue-generating delivery leader accountable for enterprise-scale retrofit, upgrade and technology deployment programs across the WhiteSky and STRATIS portfolios. Operating with minimal supervision, this role owns each project from contract handoff through project closeout, leading high-profile deployments of smart home, access control, IoT, gate and entry, community Wi-Fi, network infrastructure, bulk technology and resident technology platforms within occupied multifamily communities.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Project Ownership: Own assigned projects and programs from contract handoff through formal closeout across all phases (Initiation, Planning, Executing, Monitoring & Controlling, and Closing), managing up to 30 concurrent projects which may include large customer portfolios.
  • Contract & Scope Evaluation: Evaluate assigned contracts in detail to determine project scope, services and deliverables, and document them in the appropriate operational and project management systems; identify potential scope changes and initiate the change request process (e.g., JCO) when needed.
  • Planning & Scheduling: Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, resource plans, execution approaches and key milestones for retrofit and upgrade programs; regularly update schedules and documentation as conditions change.
  • Occupied-Unit Retrofit Management: Lead retrofit and upgrade initiatives in occupied residential communities, including unit-by-unit and building-by-building sequencing, occupied-unit access planning and resident communication strategies that minimize disruption and protect the resident experience.
  • Technology Deployment Oversight: Oversee deployments of smart home devices, access control systems, IoT sensors, community Wi-Fi, network infrastructure (including Wi-Fi, BLE, Z-Wave and LoRa networks) and resident technology platforms; coordinate device compatibility validation, programming and activation within STRATIS IoT and related platforms.
  • Quality & Closeout: Assess installation accuracy and quality against contract requirements, WhiteSky and STRATIS standards and customer expectations; verify completion of project requirements, oversee formal closeout, ensure as-built and final documentation is stored in the appropriate systems, and transition project data to the Support team.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate field services, installation partners, subcontractors, supply chain, logistics, engineering and customer stakeholders; collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Engineering, Product, Supply Chain, Carrier Management and Field Services teams to share scope and prepare for execution and delivery.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify, communicate and resolve project risks, resident-impact concerns, site readiness issues and construction-related obstacles; escalate to senior leadership and property stakeholders as appropriate, and hold firm on scope decisions.
  • Financial Management: Manage project budgets, margins, change orders, forecast accuracy, invoicing milestones, revenue recognition milestones and profitability targets; identify cost-saving opportunities and track quality, cost, schedule, change order and sales data.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as project management, engineering, information technology, computer science or business administration; equivalent experience considered.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of project management experience, including demonstrated leadership of complex retrofit and upgrade projects within occupied residential environments, preferably in construction, telecommunications, low voltage, security or technology installation.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel as needed to project sites, customer properties and vendor locations.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Experience deploying and supporting smart building technologies and network infrastructure, including Wi-Fi, BLE, Z-Wave, LoRa, and access control platforms such as Brivo, ButterflyMX, and Chirp.
  • Strong project financial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, change orders, revenue tracking, cost analysis, and profitability management.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence executive audiences and navigate complex customer environments.
  • Proven ability to analyze data, solve problems, manage risk, read technical documentation and blueprints, and adapt to changing project requirements and priorities.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated professional with strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools, capable of balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; talk or hear. The employee must have the ability to operate a personal computer and express or exchange ideas by means of the spoken word. May be required to sit and/or stand for long periods of time. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. May be required to lift or move 10+ pounds.

Salary and Benefits

RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement savings plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Performance-based bonus based on position.

Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance.

Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Pay Range

USD $85,200.00 - USD $145,200.00 /Yr.

We are seeking an intellectually curious, learning-agile, and strategic Senior Executive Recruiter to identify and attract exceptional leaders who will help shape Shield AI's future. As a fast-growing defense technology company, our hiring priorities evolve quickly, requiring adaptability, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while delivering results.

Reporting to the Head of Executive Search, the Senior Executive Recruiter – Aircraft will independently lead complex senior leadership searches across Shield AI's Aircraft organization, identifying leaders responsible for developing, producing, and scaling next-generation autonomous aircraft. This includes executive recruiting across hardware engineering, software engineering, manufacturing, production, supply chain, quality, and other critical technical and operational functions.

This senior individual contributor will own the full executive search lifecycle, from intake and market mapping through candidate assessment, offer negotiation, and close. The ideal candidate combines strong executive search fundamentals, business acumen, executive presence, operational rigor, and exceptional talent judgment. Success requires quickly developing expertise across technical disciplines, translating complex engineering requirements into effective recruiting strategies, building trusted relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, and delivering high-quality hiring outcomes. You will partner closely with business leaders, People Experience (PX) Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition colleagues to develop targeted search strategies aligned with business priorities.

Our Talent Acquisition team actively embraces AI and automation to accelerate research, improve decision-making, streamline execution, and create more capacity for high-value recruiting activities. We seek individuals who continuously identify innovative ways to improve executive search effectiveness.

What you'll do:

    Executive Search Strategy & Execution

  • Independently manage complex executive and senior leadership searches from intake and position scoping through market mapping, assessment, offer negotiation, and acceptance.
  • Partner with senior leaders to define role requirements, success profiles, assessment criteria, search strategies, and hiring milestones.
  • Identify, engage, and cultivate relationships with high-caliber, passive executive talent across aerospace and defense, AI, autonomy, software, robotics, and other relevant technical markets.
  • Build targeted executive talent pipelines supporting immediate and anticipated leadership hiring needs.
  • Execute searches across diverse technical disciplines, including mechanical, electrical, avionics, propulsion, software, autonomy, manufacturing, production, supply chain, quality, and operations.
  • Anticipate search challenges, adjust strategies, and maintain accountability for hiring outcomes.

    • Executive Stakeholder Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, hiring managers, and PX Business Partners across assigned functions.
  • Provide consultative guidance on talent availability, market dynamics, compensation expectations, and competitive positioning.
  • Establish consistent communication and reporting cadences to maintain stakeholder alignment, transparency, and accountability.
  • Influence hiring decisions through market intelligence, candidate insights, and evidence-based recommendations.
  • Proactively manage expectations, resolve obstacles, and navigate competing priorities constructively.

    • Executive Assessment & Candidate Experience

  • Conduct comprehensive executive assessments evaluating technical expertise, leadership capabilities, business impact, and alignment with Shield AI's mission and values.
  • Apply structured interviews, competency frameworks, and assessment tools to support informed hiring decisions.
  • Deliver clear, balanced candidate evaluations highlighting strengths, development areas, and potential risks.
  • Partner with interview teams to drive consistent candidate calibration and effective selection decisions.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience while building long-term relationships with executive talent.

    • Market Intelligence & Talent Mapping

  • Develop deep knowledge of executive talent markets across Aircraft engineering, manufacturing, production, supply chain, and related technical and operational functions.
  • Partner with Global Talent Sourcing to execute targeted market mapping, competitive research, and candidate identification strategies.
  • Provide actionable insights on talent availability, organizational structures, compensation trends, and competitive hiring practices.
  • Leverage recruiting technology, research tools, and analytics to improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate engagement, and search outcomes.

    • Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Execute searches using established executive recruiting processes, assessment methodologies, tools, and templates.
  • Maintain accurate, timely candidate and pipeline information in applicant tracking and recruiting systems.
  • Track and communicate search metrics, including pipeline health, candidate conversion, search velocity, and hiring outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruiting efficiency, assessment quality, and stakeholder and candidate experience.
  • Contribute executive search expertise and best practices to strengthen team processes and execution.
  • Collaborate with Talent Sourcing, Recruiting Operations, Total Rewards, PX, and business stakeholders to achieve shared hiring objectives.

    • Leverage AI to Raise the Bar

  • Integrate AI and automation into recruiting workflows to improve speed, quality, and effectiveness throughout the executive search lifecycle.
  • Apply AI to talent research, market mapping, sourcing strategy, intake preparation, candidate engagement, interview preparation, and recruiting analytics.
  • Identify repetitive or low-value activities that can be automated, creating more capacity for strategic partnership, candidate relationships, and assessment.
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools, evaluate their impact, and share successful practices across Talent Acquisition.
  • Exercise sound judgment regarding where human expertise, discretion, relationship-building, and decision-making remain essential.

    • Teamwork & Collaboration

  • Build trusted, collaborative relationships across Talent Acquisition, People Experience, Total Rewards, and business leadership.
  • Share market intelligence, candidate insights, and executive search best practices to strengthen team effectiveness.
  • Demonstrate humility, openness to feedback, and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Contribute to broader recruiting priorities while maintaining ownership and accountability for assigned searches.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 8+ years of progressive executive recruiting or search experience, including independently managing complex senior leadership searches, ideally within high-growth technology, aerospace, defense, AI, autonomy, robotics, software engineering, automotive, or related technical industries.
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting senior technical leaders across hardware, software, engineering, manufacturing, production, or operations.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical requirements into actionable recruiting and sourcing strategies across multiple engineering disciplines.
  • Strong executive sourcing, market mapping, passive candidate engagement, and assessment capabilities.
  • Proven ability to build credibility, advise, and influence senior-level hiring stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen, executive presence, communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Experience applying structured executive assessments and competency-based interviewing methodologies.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex searches simultaneously while maintaining high standards of quality, execution, and candidate experience.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems, candidate relationship management platforms, and recruiting analytics tools.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience recruiting across multiple technical disciplines rather than specializing exclusively in one talent vertical.
  • Experience recruiting cleared or clearance-eligible talent.
  • Experience recruiting executives within high-growth, mission-driven technology organizations.
  • Familiarity with executive compensation, equity programs, and complex offer negotiations.
  • Experience operating within global or matrixed organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build diverse executive talent pipelines and support equitable hiring practices.
  • Experience partnering with executive search firms and external research providers.
  • Strong understanding of organizational dynamics and technical leadership structures.
  • Ability to bring structure to ambiguity and thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Collaborative, personable, adaptable, and calm under pressure, with a positive approach to changing priorities.

Shield AI Values & Leadership Principles:

    We expect our Senior Executive Recruiters to demonstrate Shield AI's core values through their judgment, actions, and relationships.

    Do What Honor Dictates

  • Demonstrate integrity, sound judgment, transparency, and accountability in candidate assessments, hiring recommendations, and search outcomes.
  • Communicate candidly, honor commitments, and take ownership of results.

    • Live as a Servant Leader

  • Build trusted partnerships through collaboration, humility, responsiveness, and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Prioritize the success of candidates, hiring leaders, and the broader organization while contributing to shared team objectives.

    • Pursue Excellence

  • Maintain high standards for executive talent quality, search execution, and candidate experience.
  • Demonstrate urgency, persistence, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Continuously strengthen market expertise and leverage innovative tools, including AI, to improve hiring outcomes.

What success looks like:

  • Search Execution: Independently deliver complex executive searches, consistently building strong candidate pipelines and achieving high-quality hiring outcomes.
  • Strategic Partnership: Earn the confidence of senior leaders through business acumen, market intelligence, sound talent judgment, and proactive communication.
  • Operational Excellence: Demonstrate disciplined execution, accountability, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while managing competing priorities.
  • Innovation & Collaboration: Leverage AI and recruiting technology to improve efficiency and effectiveness while contributing to team success and continuous improvement.

    • This role requires substantial independence, strong functional expertise, and ownership of executive search outcomes while contributing to broader recruiting priorities within the strategic direction established by Talent Acquisition leadership.

About MD Integrations

At MD Integrations, we partner with digital health brands to power clinical care at scale. We specialize in men's and women’s health, dermatology, endocrinology, and weight management, offering telehealth solutions that help patients receive expert, personalized care—all from the comfort of their home. Join our team and be part of the movement to make specialty care more accessible and impactful.

MD Integrations is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are unable to support US visa sponsorship at this time.

Backend Engineer (PHP / Laravel)

The Backend Engineer (PHP / Laravel) designs, develops, and maintains scalable and reliable server-side applications to ensure the highest standard of system performance and stability. As a Backend Engineer, you will take ownership of features and services, troubleshoot complex issues, optimize existing code, and contribute to architectural decisions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including front-end dev, product, QA, and DevOps, collaborating both synchronously and asynchronously to deliver high-quality software, efficiently.

We are looking for a skilled, detail-oriented engineer who is comfortable with full-stack collaboration, enjoys solving challenging problems, and thrives in a remote-first, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Design, build, and optimize high-throughput RESTful APIs in PHP using the Laravel framework, writing efficient PostgreSQL queries and schema designs to support data-intensive clinical workflows. Contribute to new feature development and platform improvements within an Agile/Scrum process.
  2. Build and maintain integrations with third-party APIs and internal services, deploying and running services in Docker containers across AWS (or comparable cloud) environments to ensure secure, reliable data exchange.
  3. Write automated tests (unit, integration, and API-level) for PHP/Laravel back-end functionality and critical clinical workflows, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines using Git/GitHub-based workflows and Docker to enable continuous testing and faster, more reliable releases.
  4. Write and maintain clear technical documentation for troubleshooting guides, fixes, API integrations, and support processes, version-controlled through Git/GitHub for easy team access and updates.
  5. Monitor application health, performance, and error logs using tools such as Rollbar and AWS CloudWatch to proactively identify and address potential issues before they affect patients or providers.
  6. Identify, document, and track software defects, analyzing logs and debugging to pinpoint root causes, and work with the development team within Agile/Scrum sprints to prioritize and ensure timely resolution.
  7. Actively participate in code reviews to uphold coding standards and engineering best practices. Continuously evaluate and improve our development processes, CI/CD pipelines, and tooling (Docker, monitoring/logging systems, cloud infrastructure) to enhance team efficiency, code quality, and release velocity.
  8. Identify opportunities to formalize and document internal processes, workflows, and troubleshooting playbooks, building a knowledge base that supports faster onboarding and more consistent support.

Your Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience with PHP and Laravel framework.
  • Experience working with AWS services like Lambdas, SES, Workers, etc.
  • Solid knowledge of RESTful APIs, with ability to write automated API tests.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Deep experience with SQL databases (preferably PostgreSQL), including schema design, queries, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to use AI tools to boost productivity but does not rely on it to be able to perform.
  • Experience working with version control systems (Git) and collaborative workflows (GitHub), including CI/CD pipelines and ability to integrate automated tests into the deployment process.
  • Experience with Docker
  • Knowledge of monitoring tools (e.g., Rollbar, CloudWatch, etc.)
  • Located in the US and able to work full-time for a US employer without requiring visa sponsorship. E-Verify is used during new hire onboarding to confirm work authorization status.

Your Work DNA

  • User-Centric: A genuine passion for helping customerssucceed and a commitment to providing exceptional customer service.
  • Proactive and Solution-Oriented: A proactive approach to identifying and resolving potential issues before they escalate.
  • Team Player: Ability to work effectively as part of a team and collaborate with team members across different departments.
  • Passion for Learning: A strong desire to learn and stay up-to-date on the latest trends and developments in telehealth and healthcare technology.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary: The targeted range for this role is $105,000 to $140,000 per year commensurate with qualifications and experience.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package: Our benefits package includes 75% subsidized health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Professional Development Opportunities: We are committed to investing in our employees' professional development and offer a variety of on the job training and development opportunities.
  • Flexible Work Arrangements: We are a fully remote team who collaborate both synchronously and asynchronously to achieve the best outcomes.
  • Collaborative and Supportive Work Environment: We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment where employees are encouraged to share ideas and contribute to the company's success.

About the Role:

  • Tooling: Hands-on experience with SonarQube, Jfrog Artifactory/Artifact Registry, and integrating them into CI/CD workflows.

Title: Manager, Professional Services

About the position

The Manager in Professional Services, provides leadership to project teams in Global Professional Services, ensuring successful project delivery, client satisfaction, and operational efficiency. Leads by example, taking a proactive approach to decision-making and achieving business objectives, while maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership and direction to project teams, overseeing project delivery and customer satisfaction.
  • Lead by example, demonstrating a bias towards action and achieving business goals.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive collaboration and alignment.
  • Provide mentorship, coaching, and guidance to team members, fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and urgency.

  • Own team training and enablement in collaboration with technical team.
  • Collaborate with Finance teams to ensure accurate tracking, forecasting, and reporting of project-related metrics.
  • Represent the Professional Services organization in customer-facing engagements.
  • Conduct regular project reviews, root cause analyses, and retrospectives to identify areas for improvement.

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.
  • Comprehensive knowledge in a technical, MSP, or software consulting capacity with commiserate leadership experience.
  • Capability to manage multiple teams, ensure alignment with company goals, and drive performance improvements.
  • Advanced reporting capabilities with Excel, or other BI software.
  • Previous use of PSA software, or other related PS software.
  • Excellent managerial and organizational skills, strong decision-making, and resource allocation.
  • Strong communication skills in a consultative manner with customers and internal/external stakeholders.
  • Proven effectiveness in business troubleshooting and problem-solving.
  • Consistent confidence in speaking to technical, non-technical, and executive audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal communication and writing abilities.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.
