raw.title: Lead Specialist, Learning Scientist (Clinical)
raw.excerpt: At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to add life to a lifetime of learning.
raw.description:
At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to add life to a lifetime of learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. That’s why Pearson employees are committed to creating vibrant and enriching learning experiences designed for real-life impact. We are the world’s leading learning company, serving customers in nearly 200 countries with digital content, assessments, qualifications, and data. For us, learning isn’t just what we do. It’s who we are.

Clinical Assessments has a long-standing reputation for gold-standard assessment solutions spanning cognition, memory, neuropsychology, behavior, occupational therapy, speech and language, early childhood, personality and academic achievement.

We are seeking an innovative Lead Specialist, Learning Scientist (Clinical) to lead research across portfolio domains, including academic achievement, speech and language, cognition, and/or early childhood assessment. The ideal candidate will combine expertise in academic or applied research with clinical experience administering, interpreting, or working directly with standardized assessments within speech-language pathology, literacy, academic achievement, and/or early childhood.

This individual will provide subject-matter expertise and research leadership, translating business strategy into clear research and product priorities. They will model positive leadership behaviors, foster a collaborative and inclusive culture, and bring a strong digital mindset, including the ability to apply AI and emerging technologies to advance research, product development, and innovation.

This position will report to the Lead Learning Scientist and can be remote or based in our San Antonio, TX, or Bloomington, MN offices.

This role aligns to industry-level titles such as Research Director, Clinical Assessment Design Manager, Clinical Assessment Manager or Clinical Research Manager.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Learning Scientist (Research Director) provides scientific, clinical, and research leadership throughout the development and ongoing evolution of assessment products. Working across Content, Product, Psychometrics, Design, Editorial, and Digital Development, this role helps translate scientific evidence, clinical needs, customer needs, and business strategy into innovative, high-quality assessment solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and lead research plans supporting new product development, product revisions, and portfolio priorities.
  • Provide subject-matter expertise and scientific leadership in speech-language pathology, literacy, achievement, and/or early childhood assessment.
  • Help define product scope and assessment design, ensuring solutions are scientifically sound, clinically meaningful, and aligned with customer and business needs.
  • Lead and contribute to item development, review, and evaluation, applying research, clinical expertise, and assessment-development best practices.
  • Partner with psychometricians and research colleagues to review and interpret data and psychometric findings
  • Identify opportunities to responsibly apply AI and emerging technologies to assessment development, research practices, workflows, and product innovation.
  • Provide oversight of assessment materials, including digital interfaces, record forms, stimulus materials, manuals, administration and scoring resources, and visual and auditory stimuli.
  • Support product commercialization and adoption by contributing scientific and clinical expertise to training, product support resources, presentations, and other customer-facing materials.
  • Represent Pearson and contribute to its scientific leadership through conference presentations, technical papers, research publications, and other scholarly activities.
  • Maintain flexibility in work hours, as needed, to collaborate with international colleagues, approximately 10% of the time.
  • Travel approximately 10%.

ESSENTIAL BEHAVIORS

The successful candidate will be expected to provide leadership beyond their individual area of expertise and demonstrate behaviors that strengthen both the business and the broader team.

  • Think strategically: Connect research and scientific priorities to portfolio and business strategy, anticipate future needs, and identify opportunities to evolve assessment solutions.
  • Lead through influence: Build credibility as a trusted scientific and clinical expert, bring clarity to complex issues, and influence decisions across functions and levels.
  • Collaborate and build trust: Foster an inclusive, respectful, and accountable environment, seek diverse perspectives, communicate openly, and build strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • Drive results and accountability: Take ownership of outcomes, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage competing priorities, and help teams move complex work forward.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement: Challenge established approaches when appropriate and explore new research methods, digital capabilities, AI, and emerging technologies that can improve products and ways of working.

EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE

  • Ph.D. in Speech-Language Pathology, Communication Sciences and Disorders, Early Childhood Development, School or Clinical Psychology, or a related field from an accredited institution.
  • 5+ years professional experience in speech and language, literacy, academic achievement, school or clinical psychology, and/or early childhood.
  • Clinical experience administering, interpreting, or working directly with standardized assessments, with a strong understanding of their use in real-world clinical or educational settings.
  • Strong knowledge of test development, measurement principles, research methodology, data analysis, and psychometric principles, with the ability to apply these concepts to research and product decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate scientific and clinical evidence into strategic recommendations that balance scientific rigor, clinical relevance, customer needs, product priorities, and business objectives.
  • Strong digital fluency and curiosity, including the ability to evaluate and appropriately apply AI and emerging technologies to research, assessment development, and evolving ways of working.
  • A record of professional or scholarly contribution through activities such as conference presentations, peer-reviewed publications, technical papers, professional training, or related work.

raw.description:
About Arlo:

At Arlo, we're passionate about creating innovative and reliable solutions that help people protect what matters most to them. Our team is dedicated to delivering products that exceed our customers' expectations, while always pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of protection technology. We believe that everyone deserves to feel safe and secure, whether they're at home or away, and we're committed to providing our customers with the peace of mind they need to live their lives without worry. Arlo’s deep expertise in AI- and CV-powered analytics, cloud services, user experience, product design, and innovative wireless and RF connectivity enables the delivery of a seamless, smart security experience for Arlo users that is easy to set up and interact with every day.

Arlo is looking for a Senior Partner Release and Operations Engineer to make partner releases predictable, well communicated, and operationally reliable. This role combines technical release management, customer-facing coordination, escalation leadership, and hands-on development of the tools and documentation systems that support the Arlo Partner Platform. You will work across Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and external partners to turn complex release activity into a clear, repeatable operating model.

This role will work with both UK and US time zones, so preference is to be located in the Eastern Time Zone.

We recognize that no candidate meets 100% of the qualifications. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align with every requirement.

What You Will Do


Partner Release Planning and Change Management

  • Own release schedules for partner-facing APIs, events, device capabilities, integrations, and related platform changes.
  • Coordinate release readiness across engineering, QA, security, operations, product, and partner teams, making dependencies and decision points visible.
  • Define practical change-management processes covering versioning, compatibility, deprecation, partner communications, sandbox validation, and production rollout.
  • Create release notes, changelogs, readiness checklists, migration guidance, and other communications that help partners adopt changes successfully.
  • Manage partner testing and readiness activities before production deployment, including validation of sample applications, integration paths, and operational runbooks.

Escalation and Production Operations

  • Serve as a senior point of coordination for partner-impacting incidents, release blockers, and complex escalations.
  • Bring together the right technical owners, establish clear next actions, and communicate status, mitigations, and expected timelines to partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor release execution and partner-impacting platform health, escalating risks early and helping drive post-release reviews and corrective actions.
  • Identify recurring operational friction and work with engineering teams to improve reliability, observability, documentation, and support processes.

Release Tools, Documentation, and AI Enablement

  • Define and build tools, dashboards, workflows, and internal services that improve release visibility, partner readiness, and operational coordination.
  • Develop documentation and communication tooling that helps teams produce consistent, versioned, searchable partner content.
  • Apply AI-assisted workflows to release analysis, change-impact assessment, release-note generation, incident summaries, and partner communications while preserving review and approval controls.
  • Use structured data, APIs, tool calling, and auditable workflows to connect release systems, issue trackers, documentation, monitoring, and partner-facing surfaces.
  • Measure the effectiveness of release processes and tools, using partner feedback and operational data to guide continuous improvement.

Qualifications


Required

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, technical release management, platform operations, technical program management, or a closely related discipline.
  • Experience coordinating software or API releases across multiple engineering teams and external customers, partners, or developers.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, release controls, incident response, versioning, and backward compatibility.
  • Ability to investigate technical issues across APIs, cloud services, integrations, environments, and deployment workflows well enough to coordinate effective resolution.
  • Experience creating technical documentation, release notes, readiness plans, change communications, or operational runbooks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical changes and risk clearly to different audiences.
  • Experience using scripting, APIs, dashboards, workflow automation, or similar tools to reduce manual release and operations work.
  • Ability to work independently in an environment with changing priorities and multiple concurrent releases.

Preferred

  • Experience with B2B SaaS platforms, developer platforms, partner ecosystems, connected devices, or IoT integrations.
  • Experience with release dashboards, status pages, service-management systems, or deployment and observability tooling
  • Experience supporting firmware, mobile, streaming, or event-driven platform releases.
  • Experience building lightweight web applications, internal tools, or automation services.
  • Practical experience applying AI or LLM-based tools to documentation, issue triage, operational analysis, or workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with OpenAPI, REST APIs, event notifications, queues, and common integration patterns.
  • ITIL, PMP, Scrum, or other relevant training or certification.

Key Competencies

  • Partner advocacy: Keeps partner impact visible and turns partner needs into concrete internal actions.
  • Operational judgment: Recognizes release risk early and balances speed, reliability, and communication quality.
  • Technical translation: Makes complex platform behavior understandable and actionable for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Builder mindset: Improves processes by building durable tools and automation, not only by coordinating manual steps.
  • Calm escalation leadership: Creates clarity and momentum during incidents, blockers, and high-visibility releases.

The pay range for this position reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries at commencement of employment and is expected to be between USD$125,000-175,000/year. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including role, job-related knowledge, skills, relevant education and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including bonus, equity, and a full range of benefits. Details of all benefits will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

We’re committed to inclusivity and selecting the strongest candidate—no matter their background. Even if you don’t meet every listed qualification, we encourage you to apply. We’re happy to support growth in areas essential to the role. Interested in learning more about our workplace? raw.description:
About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager to join our Accounting team at a fast-growing global software company. This role will play a critical role in ensuring accurate and compliant revenue recognition while helping scale the revenue accounting function through process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.

The Senior Revenue Accountant will own key aspects of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, serve as a technical accounting resource for complex customer arrangements under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, and partner closely with Sales, Legal, Revenue Operations and other stakeholders throughout the quote-to-cash lifecycle.

This is both an operational and advisory role. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting judgment with a practical business mindset, is comfortable evaluating complex and non-standard deal structures, and proactively identifies opportunities to use technology, data, automation, and AI to improve the quality, speed, and scalability of revenue accounting processes.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Accounting & Technical Expertise

  • Own key components of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, ensuring accurate and timely revenue recognition, accounting, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Evaluate executed and proposed customer contracts under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, including complex and non-standard arrangements.
  • Perform technical accounting assessments involving standalone selling price (SSP), multiple performance obligations, contract modifications, variable consideration, material rights, early renewals, future purchase options, SLA credits, swaps, termination provisions, and other complex contract terms.
  • Prepare clear, well-supported technical accounting analyses and memos documenting significant judgments and conclusions.
  • Maintain contract review procedures and documentation to support consistent application of company revenue recognition policies.
  • Stay current on relevant U.S. GAAP, IFRS, FASB, SEC, and financial reporting developments and assess their impact on company policies and practices.

Revenue Close & Financial Reporting

  • Prepare and/or review revenue-related journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations and fluctuation analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, unbilled accounts receivable, and other revenue-related accounts.
  • Investigate unusual trends, discrepancies, and accounting issues and drive timely resolution.
  • Develop and monitor relevant revenue accounting KPIs to improve visibility into process performance, data quality, and close execution.
  • Support management reporting, financial statement preparation, and ad hoc revenue analyses as required.

Systems, Automation & AI

  • Manage and review revenue accounting activities within NetSuite ARM or similar revenue recognition systems, including sales order approval, revenue arrangements, allocation and schedule adjustments, order activation, and revenue schedule maintenance.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive work across the revenue accounting and quote-to-cash lifecycle.
  • Design, prototype, implement, or help deploy AI-enabled tools, agents, and automated workflows that improve efficiency, scalability, analytical capability, and control.
  • Apply a clean-sheet mindset to existing processes, challenging legacy workflows and identifying opportunities to simplify or redesign them using generative AI, advanced automation.
  • Leverage automation to enhance areas such as contract review, reconciliations, fluctuation analysis, large-dataset analysis, audit support, and management reporting.

Cross-Functional Business Partnership

  • Partner proactively with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, FP&A, Product, Engineering, and IT to evaluate the accounting implications of proposed transactions.
  • Provide accounting guidance before deal execution to help the business structure arrangements in a manner that supports commercial objectives while maintaining accounting compliance.
  • Advise on the revenue implications of new products, pricing models, go-to-market initiatives, and changes to commercial practices.
  • Translate complex accounting conclusions into clear, actionable guidance for non-accounting stakeholders.
  • Identify and resolve contract, system, or process discrepancies and escalate significant matters to revenue accounting leadership as appropriate.
  • Consider global implications of accounting conclusions and process changes and support consistent policies and practices across regions.

Controls, Audit & Process Excellence

  • Maintain high-quality, audit-ready documentation supporting revenue accounting judgments, reconciliations, and controls.
  • Own or support key revenue-related internal controls and update control procedures as systems, business processes, products, and policies evolve.
  • Perform risk assessments associated with revenue process and system changes and recommend appropriate control enhancements.
  • Coordinate with internal and external auditors during interim and annual audits, including preparation and ownership of PBC schedules and responses to audit inquiries.
  • Lead or participate in high-impact revenue accounting projects and process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • CPA or equivalent preferred.
  • Approximately 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful experience in revenue accounting; Big Four or other public accounting experience is preferred.
  • Strong technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP and ASC 606, including demonstrated experience evaluating complex customer contracts and revenue recognition judgments.
  • Experience with SaaS, software, subscription, or other recurring revenue business models, including multi-element or multiple-performance-obligation arrangements.
  • Experience with ERP, billing, and revenue recognition systems; experience with NetSuite and NetSuite ARM is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to own revenue close activities and deliver accurate results under tight monthly and quarterly reporting deadlines.
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical accounting matters effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and cross-functional initiatives with limited supervision.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

Bring strong technical judgment to complex revenue recognition matters.

  • Execute a high-quality, timely, and increasingly automated revenue close.
  • Become a trusted advisor to commercial and finance stakeholders on complex transactions and new business models.
  • Reduce manual work and improve scalability through thoughtful use of systems, automation, data, and AI.
  • Strengthen revenue accounting documentation, controls, and audit readiness as the company grows.
  • Take ownership, move with urgency, operate effectively through ambiguity, and continuously raise the standard for the revenue accounting function.

🧬 About us

We’re iubenda, the team turning compliance into a growth engine. We help over 110K businesses all around the world build trust, boost performance, and grow without limits. Now part of team.blue ( we’re scaling privacy tech with confidence, creativity, and a little bit of attitude. Join a team that moves fast, thinks big, and makes privacy feel exciting again!

🎯 Mission & Core Purpose

Your mission is to turn the iubenda affiliate program into a scalable and predictable acquisition channel that brings new paying customers every month.

As our Affiliate Manager, you’ll own the iubenda affiliate end to end: strategy, partner recruitment, activation, incentives, tracking and reporting. You’ll work with web designers, developers, agencies, consultants, content creators, review sites and communities who recommend iubenda to their own audiences.

You’ll be part of the marketing team, next to Paid, Lifecycle and SEO & AI Search. This means you can use the same data, content and campaigns to grow the channel faster. It’s a hands-on role: you set the plan, and you also run the outreach yourself.

💼 Key Responsibilities

Program Strategy & Ownership:

  • Own the affiliate program strategy, quarterly goals and roadmap for iubenda.

  • Design and improve the commission model, incentives, offers and promo codes, within the agreed budget and margin targets.

  • Decide which partner segments and markets to focus on, based on data.

Partner Recruitment:

  • Build and work a pipeline of new partners: web designers and developers, agencies, WordPress and website builder communities, privacy and legal consultants, SaaS review and comparison sites, bloggers, YouTubers and newsletter owners.

  • Find, reach out, pitch and sign up new partners, and negotiate terms with high-potential ones.

  • Use tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, LinkedIn and affiliate networks to find partners who already rank, or get cited in AI search, for topics close to our products.

Activation & Growth:

  • Turn new sign-ups into active, high-performing partners with a strong onboarding, ready-to-use assets and clear messaging.

  • Build a tiered approach: personal management for top partners, scaled communication (partner newsletters, automated sequences) for the long tail.

  • Re-engage partners who have gone quiet, and grow the output of the best ones with co-marketing, dedicated landing pages and exclusive offers.

Program Operations:

  • Own the affiliate platform setup, tracking and attribution, together with the Analytics and Product teams.

  • Review commissions and coordinate payouts on time and accurately.

  • Keep the program clean: detect fraud, brand bidding and misuse of our brand.

  • Make sure partners describe iubenda correctly, without promises like “100% compliant” or “guaranteed compliance”.

  • Keep partner-facing materials and documentation up to date.

Experimentation & Analytics:

  • Run growth experiments on outreach, partner types, incentives, offers and landing pages. Measure the results, then scale the winners.

  • Track recruitment, activation, clicks, conversions, new MRR and partner ROI by partner, segment and market.

  • Share clear weekly and monthly updates with your recommendations.

Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Work with Lifecycle, Paid, SEO & AI Search and Content on campaigns, partner newsletters and co-marketing ideas.

  • Share partner and market feedback with Product and Marketing.

👤 Your Profile

You’re a self-starter who enjoys building relationships as much as looking at numbers. You’re comfortable starting conversations with people you’ve never met, and you follow up until you get a result. You think in funnels (recruited, activated, converting) and you know where to push next.

You like to test new ideas fast, keep what works and stop what doesn’t. You work well on your own in a remote, international team, and you enjoy owning a channel from start to finish.

💡Experience & Skills

  • 3-5 years of experience in affiliate marketing, partnerships or partner/performance marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or web tools.

  • A proven track record of recruiting and scaling affiliate partners and growing revenue from the channel.

  • Hands-on experience with affiliate platforms or networks (e.g. Impact, PartnerStack, Rewardful, FirstPromoter, CJ, Awin or similar).

  • A good understanding of tracking, attribution, commission models and affiliate KPIs.

  • Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-building skills.

  • A data-driven approach: comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards and analytics tools to decide where to focus.

  • Excellent English. A second European language (Italian, Spanish, German or French) is a strong plus.

  • Strong organisation and follow-through, so no partner conversation slips through the cracks.

✨Nice to have

  • A network in web design, developer, agency or WordPress communities.

  • Experience with creator partnerships (YouTube, newsletters, LinkedIn).

  • Basic knowledge of SEO, content marketing and AI search.

  • Interest in privacy, data protection or legal tech.

🌐 Location

We're a remote-first company. You can work from wherever you're most productive in the world.
For those based in Italy or nearby, if you enjoy a mix of remote and in-person work, you can also take advantage of our offices in Milan and Bologna.
For those based in Mauritius, while you can work from anywhere on the island, we encourage regular in-person collaboration at our Port Louis office, typically once per week.

  • Collaborative, multicultural team🧩Join a team of talented, international colleagues in a friendly, open, and highly collaborative environment.

raw.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
raw.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Partnerships & BD expert to grow our banking, deposits, and investing partners, and to bring on the ones we haven't met yet. Most of the job, roughly 70 to 80 percent, is growing the partners we already have: bigger budgets, better economics, broader distribution. The rest is net new, mostly warm, with real outreach on the investing side where the relationships don't exist yet.

You'll work alongside our Head of Partnerships, who will continue to focus on our largest strategic partners. On those strategic partners, you'll run the operations. Across the rest of banking, deposits, and investing, you own it fully, operationally and strategically. That's what gives the Head of Partnerships room for the biggest bets, and it's what makes this seat yours.

This isn't a support role, and it isn't customer service. The job is to grow relationships, not just service them.

WHY THIS SEAT

  • A category to own. Banking, deposits, and investing partners outside our largest strategic accounts are yours, start to finish.
  • A partner, not a handoff. Our Head of Partnerships works closely alongside you for your first 90 days, and the goal is full independence by about day 120.
  • Room to shape it. You'll inherit real momentum, but the strategy in these categories is still being written, and you'll help write it.
  • Close to the media. You'll connect what partners need to placements across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network, which is where a good partnership becomes an extraordinary one.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership on the deals that matter.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Direct experience on the advertiser side of a financial comparison publisher, marketplace, or performance network, managing bank, deposit, or investing partners.
  • A record of growing accounts, not just servicing them. You can walk through a partner whose budget you grew and what moved it.
  • Sales DNA. You open doors and close. Warm relationships are most of it, but you're comfortable with cold outreach, especially to investing apps.
  • Ownership of the details. URL approvals, budget changes, CPA moves, placement and widget coordination: you run them yourself and nothing drops.
  • You figure it out without being pushed, and you pull in account management, product, media, analytics, compliance, legal, and finance to get it done.
  • Fluency in performance economics, including CPA, CPL, CPC, and revenue share, and the business acumen to use performance, revenue, and unit-economic data in a negotiation.
  • Strong communication, relationship building, and negotiation across several partners and opportunities at once.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Publisher experience, or enough of the language to hold the conversation.
  • Experience in wealth management, financial advisory, RIAs, or advisor networks.
  • Existing relationships with banks, fintech companies, investment platforms, or related financial-services companies.
  • Experience selling customer acquisition, media, lead generation, or performance-based marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Existing partners

  • Budget growth, better unit economics, broader product coverage, and a bigger share of wallet with the partners you own.
  • The operations on our largest strategic banking partners, alongside the Head of Partnerships.
  • Partner operations from onboarding through campaign management, reporting, issue resolution, and optimization.
  • Proposals that connect a partner's goals to placements, audiences, and distribution across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network.
  • Accurate pipeline, forecasts, partner updates, and next steps.
  • Launch Potato's presence at industry events and partner meetings.

New partners

  • A pipeline across banking, deposits, investing, and wealth.
  • Reaching the right decision makers through relationships, referrals, events, and outbound.
  • Partner conversations from first outreach through pitch, deal negotiation, contracting, and launch.
  • A clear read on each partner's growth goals, economics, products, and target customers.

WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

  • First 90 days: you're learning the book side by side with the Head of Partnerships and running operations on the partners you'll own.
  • By about day 120: you run your partners independently.
  • By month 6: you're directing internal traffic and connecting partner activity to media opportunity.
  • Year one: larger budgets and stronger economics across existing partners, new banks and investing advertisers live, and the Head of Partnerships focused on our largest, most strategic deals.

THIS ISN'T THE RIGHT SEAT IF YOU

  • Want to hunt, close, and hand the account to someone else.
  • Want someone else to own the operations.
  • Need a playbook handed to you before you move.
  • Would rather service an account than grow it.

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

You will work closely with Enterprise Account Executives to strategize, identify, engage, and advance opportunities across the data infrastructure and AI storage landscape.

Outbound Prospecting

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy explaining complex solutions in a way that everybody gets excited? If so, read on!

About Picus

Picus Security is an exposure validation company. One platform proves what attackers can exploit and what your defenses stop, turning every exposure into a defensible decision, autonomously and at the machine speed today's AI threats demand.

Picus validates attack surfaces, exposures, and security controls as one continuous loop: validate, decide, fix, re-validate. Instead of ranking findings by severity score, Picus proves which exposures are genuinely exploitable in your environment, including the business-critical, restricted, and air-gapped assets a live exploit can never safely touch, so teams act on what truly matters and resolve each exposure into a clear call to patch, mitigate, monitor, or accept with evidence.

The Picus Platform spans Autonomous Penetration Testing, Exposure Validation, and Breach and Attack Simulation, unified by Picus Swarm, a swarm of AI agents that runs the whole validation loop continuously. It reaches across on-prem, hybrid cloud, and endpoint environments, with 75+ integrations that ingest from scanners like Tenable and Wiz and operationalize through your EDR, SIEM, firewall, and ticketing tools.

The pioneer of Breach and Attack Simulation, Picus proves and improves the security controls you already own, doubling control effectiveness within three months. Picus holds a 95% recommendation rate, 4.9 on G2, and 4.8 on Gartner Peer Insights, and is the #1 Leader on Frost Radar for Automated Security Validation.

About The Role

A results-driven individual with an entrepreneurial mindset who takes the initiative and thrives in a dynamic environment, then this is a great opportunity to play a pivotal role in a fast-growing cybersecurity company. We are looking for a smart and driven professional to have a direct impact on the future of our business by helping to influence global adoption of our award-winning Picus Security Validation Platform.
Picus Security is looking for a seasoned, hardworking, and overachieving Customer Success Architect (CSA) with proven experience and a passion for executing value-driven security solutions. You will be responsible for onboarding new customers, expanding our platform capabilities, and retaining our Enterprise customer base. The Architect will create customer value and contribute to the overall sales team and business success. This position requires that the candidate be a subject matter expert with business acumen.
The role will align with the Regional Solution Architect, Sales VP, Product Management, as well as supporting roles in Marketing and Customer Success. The Architect will work within our Solution Architect team and collaborate within the Sales organization to define solutions for enterprise customers while aligning with partners to accelerate revenue and strategic growth initiatives. The position requires a seasoned Customer Success profile with a proven track record of revenue growth and team collaboration.

What You'll Do

  • Refine and scale core customer success processes such as onboarding, adoption planning, platform expansion, health monitoring, and quarterly business reviews,
  • Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to drive product adoption, demonstrate value realization, and identify expansion opportunities,
  • Lead customer advocacy initiatives including case studies, reference calls, and participation in customer advisory boards,
  • Build a working relationship with senior management to present a vision of how Picus is utilised and incorporated into the operations team
  • Represent Picus customer success stories and best practices at events, panels, and webinars,
  • Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Support teams to ensure seamless customer experience and resolution of escalations,
  • Provide customer-driven feedback on product enhancements and feature requests,
  • Willing to travel within APAC for on-site customer meetings, training sessions, and key industry events.

What You Have

  • BS degree or combination of education and pre-sales/customer success experience in Security, Cloud, and IT Systems,

Company Overview

Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.

As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution.

Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide.

Why Join Planview?

At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works.

Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn,Instagram, and X.


The Opportunity

Planview is looking for a Business Development Representative to join our Sales Development team. This is the fully qualified, experienced BDR role at Planview: you will drive net-new pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting into enterprise accounts, using firmographic and intent data to identify the right personas and buying groups. You'll execute high-volume, phone-first outreach supported by email and LinkedIn, conduct discovery conversations to assess fit and buying stage, and convert qualified conversations into Sales Qualified Leads that meet Account Executive acceptance criteria. You'll make informed decisions with input from management on projects that are often complex and not clearly defined, build cross-functional relationships with Marketing, Sales Ops, and RevOps, and use AI-powered sales intelligence to continuously sharpen your targeting, personalization, and outbound efficiency.


What You'll Do

  • Drive net-new pipeline creation across new-logo enterprise accounts through proactive, outbound prospecting.

  • Identify and engage target personas and buying groups using firmographic data, account context, and sales intelligence tools.

  • Execute high-volume, phone-first outbound outreach, supported by email and LinkedIn messaging, to generate qualified conversations.

  • Use AI to build dynamic prospecting lists and personalize outbound messaging with AI-driven content suggestions and templates.

  • Conduct discovery conversations to assess business challenges, solution fit, buying stage, timeline, and stakeholder involvement.

  • Convert qualified outbound conversations into Sales Qualified Leads that meet Account Executive acceptance criteria.

  • Monitor AI-driven dashboards to prioritize accounts based on response likelihood and engagement signals.

  • Build and manage outbound sequences and cadences, partnering with Account Executives on account planning and handoff.

  • Capture all prospecting activity, qualification details, and outcomes in Salesforce and Outreach with accurate notes and dispositions.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales Ops, and RevOps to share feedback on messaging, personas, and objection trends, and contribute to continuous improvement of outbound workflows.


What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in outbound sales development, prospecting, or a similar new-business role, ideally in SaaS or B2B technology.

  • Proven track record of generating qualified pipeline through high-volume outbound prospecting (calls, email, LinkedIn).

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to translate complex product capabilities into compelling business value for prospects.

  • Experience using CRM and sales engagement tools (e.g., Salesforce, Outreach) and comfort adopting AI-powered prospecting and intelligence tools.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong organizational and time-management abilities.

  • Self-motivated and resilient, with a demonstrated ability to prioritize work independently and exercise good judgment on complex, evolving projects.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


Benefits at Planview

At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:

  • Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.

  • Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
  • Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
  • Employee Referral bonus program.
  • Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
  • Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

OZ - Principal Consultant - Databricks

We believe work should be innately rewarding and a team-building venture. Working with our teammates and clients should be an enjoyable journey where we can learn, grow as professionals, and achieve amazing results. Our core values revolve around this philosophy. We are relentlessly committed to helping our clients achieve their business goals, leapfrog the competition, and become leaders in their industry. What drives us forward is the culture of creativity combined with a disciplined approach, passion for learning & innovation, and a ‘can-do’ attitude!

What We're Looking For:

We're seeking a highly experienced Principal Consultant - Databricks to serve as the senior technical authority for complex enterprise data-platform engagements. The ideal candidate combines deep Azure Databricks and Lakehouse expertise with strong consulting, architecture, delivery leadership, and executive communication skills.

Position Overview:

As a Principal Consultant - Databricks, you will own the technical vision, target-state architecture, standards, and roadmaps for Azure Databricks engagements from discovery through production delivery. You will shape secure, scalable Lakehouse solutions, guide multidisciplinary teams, support pre-sales and delivery planning, and ensure that platform decisions align with customer outcomes, operational requirements, security, performance, reliability, and cost goals. This is a remote U.S.-based role working primarily in the Eastern Time Zone.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Technical Vision and Architecture: Define target-state architecture, principles, standards, and roadmaps for complex Azure Databricks engagements.
  • Lead Discovery and Architecture Workshops: Translate business priorities, security needs, operational constraints, and success measures into actionable solution designs.
  • Design Enterprise Lakehouse Platforms: Architect secure and scalable solutions spanning ingestion, storage, transformation, orchestration, analytics, data sharing, and AI/ML enablement.
  • Establish Platform Standards: Define engineering, governance, identity, networking, CI/CD, observability, reliability, performance, and cost-optimization practices.
  • Provide Delivery Oversight: Review critical implementation artifacts, identify risks early, guide technical decisions, and maintain alignment between sold and delivered solutions.
  • Support Pre-sales and Solutioning: Contribute to qualification, solution shaping, estimates, staffing plans, proposals, statements of work, demonstrations, and executive presentations.
  • Build Reusable Consulting Assets: Develop reference architectures, accelerators, assessment methods, estimation models, delivery playbooks, and thought leadership.
  • Mentor and Collaborate: Guide architects, engineers, and consultants while partnering with Databricks, Microsoft, customer stakeholders, sales teams, and internal practices.

What You're Looking For:

If you’re looking for an opportunity to work in a fast-growing market, surrounded by talented, motivated, and global colleagues who thrive on helping clients meet their most pressing business goals, we are the company for you. If you’re driven, passionate, and want to be a ’key player’ in a company’s growth, we invite you to make a difference with a company that its employees define. We want you to be bold, take risks, and imagine a better way to work. We should talk if we just described you!

About Us:

With more than 25 years of experience, OZ brings trusted, deep expertise in Azure Cloud Solutions, Power Apps Application Development, Intelligent Automation, Enterprise Application Integration, Azure Data Strategy, and Artificial Intelligence to deliver rapid, effective results.

As a Microsoft Partner, our teams act as trusted advisors, combining technical depth with strong business acumen to solve complex challenges and drive measurable results.

OZ is dedicated to creating a seamless blend between work and life, offering our team the flexibility to work hybrid and/or remotely. We provide competitive pay and a well-rounded benefits package, including full health coverage, a 401K, and unlimited PTO. Our culture is built on collaboration, growth, and balance - you’ll have the tools and support you need to thrive. Join a team that truly lives its values and invests in your success.

Requirements

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise data and analytics consulting, including:
    • 5+ years architecting and delivering production Databricks or Lakehouse solutions
    • 3+ years in senior technical leadership, solution architecture, or principal-level consulting roles.
    • 3+ years in an insurance firm in a consulting capacity
  • Demonstrated experience as the senior technical authority for complex enterprise data-platform engagements, with accountability from discovery through production delivery.
  • Deep Azure Databricks expertise across platform architecture, data engineering, Unity Catalog governance, operationalization, performance, and cost management.
  • Strong command of Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, SQL, Delta Lake, batch and streaming patterns, ETL/ELT, data modeling, data quality, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure networking and private connectivity, ADLS, secrets and key management, monitoring, and related Azure data services.
  • Experience with Git-based development, automated testing, CI/CD, environment promotion, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability, runbooks, and support models.
  • Strong consulting and business acumen, with the ability to connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes, delivery risk, scope, margin, adoption, and platform consumption.
  • Executive-level written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the technical depth to engage architects and engineers.
  • Experience in discovery, estimation, staffing, proposal or SOW development, technical pre-sales, delivery leadership, and multidisciplinary team guidance.
  • Self-directed, collaborative leadership with sound judgment, resilience, empathy, and the ability to create structure in ambiguous situations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional strongly preferred.
  • Azure Platform Architect Badge and/or Databricks Data + AI Platform Administrator accreditation preferred.
  • Databricks Partner Champion or Delivery Expert recognition, partner or Center of Excellence leadership, co-sell experience, or work in regulated and security-sensitive industries.
  • Candidates without an appropriate Databricks credential must be willing to complete an OZ-approved, role-aligned certification or accreditation path after joining.
  • Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate or Machine Learning Professional is a plus.
  • Experience with large-scale platform modernization, cloud transformation, data-warehouse migration, or consolidation involving Databricks.
  • Experience creating reusable offerings, accelerators, reference architectures, assessment frameworks, delivery playbooks, or intellectual property.
  • Experience overseeing production analytics, machine-learning, or AI workloads beyond proof-of-concept delivery.

Tools & Technologies:

  • Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Lakeflow Jobs and pipelines, Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, and SQL.
  • Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Storage/ADLS, Azure networking, Private Link, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor.
  • Git, GitHub and/or Azure DevOps, automated testing, CI/CD, Terraform or comparable infrastructure as code, Databricks CLI and APIs, and Declarative Automation Bundles.
  • MLflow, model serving, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, and Microsoft Purview exposure preferred.

Competencies:

  • Databricks and Lakehouse architecture leadership
  • Enterprise data-platform design and governance
  • Technical pre-sales and solution shaping
  • Delivery oversight and risk management
  • Performance, reliability, security, and cost optimization
  • Executive stakeholder communication and facilitation
  • Team mentorship and cross-functional collaboration

  • Competitive Pay
  • 401K
  • Health Coverage

Job Summary

Management Analyst

Aptive Resources is seeking a Management Analyst to support health system transformation, implementation and operations, and healthcare business-enabling services for the Office of Suicide Prevention within the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA). This role will focus heavily on supporting analysis of the efficacy of implementation of the Emergent Suicide Care benefit (ESCb) to ensure eligible Veterans receive the benefit appropriately.

This position supports VA’s implementation of the ESCb as part of the legislatively mandated COMPACT Act of 2020 requirements. This project focuses on supporting full benefit implementation through development of standard operating procedures, evaluation of benefit implementation processes across VHA offices, data analysis to support leadership decision-making, and development of communication artifacts to raise awareness of the ESCb.

This position is well suited for a consultant who thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments, and demonstrates adaptability, perseverance, and strong interpersonal skills. The candidate should also be comfortable working in a sensitive, mission-driven environment where suicide prevention and related topics are regularly discussed.

In this role, you will support program design, audits, and evaluations across a range of task areas including program analysis, data analysis, strategy development, meeting coordination, metrics development, and risk management. You will be expected to organize and prioritize work effectively, manage multiple assignments simultaneously, and remain adaptable as client needs evolve.

Primary Responsibilities

Program & Process Evaluation

  • Conduct research and structured reviews of documentation, policies, standard operating procedures, and guidance to evaluate program performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Conduct organizational assessments and gap analyses comparing current and target states, documenting findings and recommendations.
  • Apply critical, analytical, and creative thinking to help define and refine project and program requirements, objectives, and strategies.
  • Support day-to-day program execution by tracking deliverables, maintaining project artifacts and workplans, and coordinating activities across team members and stakeholders.
  • Present findings, analyses, and proposed solutions in client-facing meetings and working sessions, adapting communication style to engage internal and external audiences.
  • Coordinate and collaborate across multidisciplinary, geographically dispersed teams, establishing and maintaining constructive professional relationships with stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate initiative and perseverance by independently managing tasks, following through on assignments, and navigating obstacles to drive progress.

Data Evaluation & Analysis

  • Perform detailed qualitative analyses of program documentation, data, and stakeholder input, breaking down complex information to identify insights and develop clear, actionable, well-supported recommendations.
  • Support quantitative data review and basic metrics development to complement qualitative findings and inform program evaluation.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate documentation, records, presentations, and analytical deliverables, ensuring information is clearly communicated and appropriately formatted.
  • Continuously build and apply relevant knowledge, quickly getting up to speed on complex programmatic, policy, or operational topics to inform evaluation work.

Minimum Qualifications

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 4+ years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, healthcare administration, project management, process engineering, business or data analysis, change management, or related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, communications, management, statistics, analytics, finance, or related field.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States.

Desired Qualifications

Desired Skills and Attributes

  • Strong organizational, prioritization, analytical, and critical thinking skills, with high attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently as a self-starter, while also being an active and collaborative team participant.
  • Demonstrated capability to adapt to change, manage ambiguity, and perform effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and logically, both in writing and verbally, to a wide range of audiences.
  • Ability to synthesize qualitative information, such as interviews, document reviews, and stakeholder feedback, into clear findings, along with comfort working with quantitative data and basic metrics to support evaluation.
  • Strong commitment to professionalism, continuous learning, and relationship-building, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for delivering high-quality work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint) and document management best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for and implement improvements to processes and workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain confidentiality.
  • Experience or familiarity with policy implementation in complex organizations, including translating guidance into operational processes cross-checking against applicable legislative and regulatory requirements, and supporting adoption across stakeholders.
  • Experience or familiarity with behavioral health, mental health care systems, or suicide prevention and intervention efforts, including comfort working in sensitive, mission-driven environments.
  • Prior experience supporting the VA, VHA, and/or a similar federal organization.

Physical Requirements

Physical Requirements: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use a computer keyboard and mouse, and communicate verbally and in writing. The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, bend, or lift up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

About Aptive

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. Founded: 2012. Employees: 300+ nationwide.

EEO Statement

Aptive is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, parental status, veteran status, age, disability, or any other protected class. Veterans, members of the Reserve and National Guard, and transitioning active-duty service members are highly encouraged to apply. If you’re energized by transformation, passionate about software engineering, and ready to help lay the technical bedrock for a digital-first future—we want to talk to you.

We've been nominated a "Best Place to Work" and are a leading provider of vehicle after-market tires and repair services. We are increasing our footprint rapidly through both organic growth and acquisitions and seek candidates who are looking for a long-term career path and capable of growing into roles of greater responsibility.

Scope

The National Account Manager will manage all activities related to sales and relationships with National Strategic Accounts This responsibility entails both managing and growing a portfolio of underleveraged accounts (25%), and a strong emphasis on new business development, winning and onboarding target accounts (75%) Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop sales strategies, programs and plans for existing and new business with key large strategic accounts Primary focus on growing Sun Auto share, presenting SATS (Sun Auto Tire & Service) SAFE (Sun Auto Fleet Enterprises) National Account Program, while growing share within Manufacturing Partner/FMC (Fleet Management Company) programs

  • Uses high level of strategic aptitude to take fleet service offerings and translate to featured benefits among portfolio of accounts
  • Relies on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals A wide variety of creativity and latitude is expected

  • Proficiency in analyzing data and interpreting market trends
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively

description: Role OverviewThe Senior Systems Engineer (L3) at GXA is a highly experienced, hands-on escalation engineer responsible for resolving complex technical issues across a broad MSP environment.

raw.title: Senior Systems Engineer (L3 - Network-Focused)
raw.excerpt: Role OverviewThe Senior Systems Engineer (L3) at GXA is a highly experienced, hands-on escalation engineer responsible for resolving complex technical issues across a broad MSP environment.
raw.description:
Role Overview

The Senior Systems Engineer (L3) at GXA is a highly experienced, hands-on escalation engineer responsible for resolving complex technical issues across a broad MSP environment. While this role brings deep expertise in networking, firewalls, and infrastructure, it is not limited to networking work. Instead, this engineer serves as the primary escalation point for the most challenging service issues and plays a critical role in strengthening overall service delivery.

This position exists to eliminate recurring escalations, reduce cross-team dependencies, and raise the technical maturity of the service organization. The Senior Systems Engineer partners closely with L1/L2 engineers, service leadership, and project teams to troubleshoot advanced issues, improve standards, and ensure stable, scalable client environments.

The ideal candidate has strong, practical networking expertise and solid mid-to-high level experience across standard MSP support, including servers, cloud services, identity, endpoint management, and core business applications. Networking escalations will be a key responsibility, but day-to-day work will span a wide range of service issues and technical mentorship.

Core Focus of the Role

  • Act as a senior escalation engineer responsible for resolving the most complex service issues across client environments, regardless of technology domain
  • Own issues through to resolution, reducing ticket reassignment, repeated escalations, and dependency on multiple teams
  • Provide deep technical support across core MSP platforms and infrastructure, including servers, cloud services, identity, endpoints, and networking
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for advanced networking and firewall issues when they arise, ensuring rapid and accurate resolution

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Technical Execution

  • Serve as the final escalation point for complex service and infrastructure issues across client environments, spanning servers, cloud services, identity, endpoints, and networking
  • Diagnose and resolve advanced issues across common MSP platforms, including:
    • Microsoft 365, Azure, and identity services
    • Active Directory, Exchange, and core server infrastructure
    • Virtualization platforms and hybrid environments
    • Networking and firewalls as a primary technical strength
  • Own troubleshooting end-to-end, from root cause analysis through resolution, without unnecessary dependency on other teams

Infrastructure & Networking Specialization

  • Act as the lead escalation engineer for advanced networking issues when required, including:
    • Firewalls (Fortinet, SonicWall, Meraki, etc.)
    • VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs, NAT, and site-to-site connectivity
  • Design, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure that spans on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments, ensuring stability, security, and scalability

Service Impact & Operational Efficiency

  • Resolve complex tickets directly rather than deferring or reassigning, improving customer experience and resolution time
  • Reduce recurring escalations by identifying systemic issues and driving permanent fixes
  • Produce clear documentation and resolution notes that raise the troubleshooting capability of L1/L2 engineers
  • Partner with service leadership to improve standards, workflows, and service velocity as GXA scales

Required Skills & Experience

  • Senior-level MSP support experience with the ability to independently resolve complex tickets across multiple technology domains
  • Proven experience working as an L3 or senior escalation engineer in a managed services environment
  • Strong, hands-on experience supporting core MSP platforms, including:
    • Microsoft 365 and Azure (identity, access, core services)
    • Active Directory, Exchange, and identity-related troubleshooting
    • Windows Server and common server roles
    • Virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, or equivalent)
    • Endpoint management and standard MSP tooling (RMM, PSA, backup, security tools)
  • Demonstrated ability to own tickets end-to-end, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent fixes
  • Solid practical networking experience, including:
    • Firewall configuration and troubleshooting
    • VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs, and subnetting
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical issues to both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Deep expertise in networking and firewalls within MSP client environments
  • Hands-on experience with firewall platforms such as Fortinet, SonicWall, Meraki, or similar
  • Experience designing or remediating complex or problematic client networks
  • Background supporting hybrid cloud environments and network-integrated cloud services
  • Experience mentoring or upskilling L1/L2 engineers through documentation, shadowing, or technical guidance
  • Familiarity with automation, scripting, or process improvement initiatives in an MSP
  • Experience working in organizations leveraging offshore or distributed service teams

Why This Role Matters at GXA

GXA is improving service efficiency rapidly and scaling intentionally. This role exists to stabilize and strengthen the technical core so growth does not create downstream service friction. The right hire will have immediate, measurable impact on ticket resolution speed and escalation volume.

raw.description:
About HumanSignal

Real-world data is the competitive edge in AI.

HumanSignal is a human data partner for companies building AI models and products. Our customers ship better AI, faster, because we partner with their researchers from real-world data creation to annotation to delivery.

We design and create datasets from scratch, recruit and manage the domain experts who evaluate model output, and run everything through our own platform, Label Studio, the open-source standard for data labeling and evaluation, used by over 1 million practitioners worldwide.

We specialize in the operationally complex: real-world data collection, multimodal pipelines, and multi-step workflows. Advanced ML and AI teams use our enterprise platform to run their own data factories, and our services team to extend their reach where in-house capacity runs out.

If you want to do work that materially shapes how the next generation of AI products gets built, we'd love to talk.

About the OpportunityWe're looking for graphic design professionals to rate the quality of design work, helping AI models learn what makes a design effective.

Key Details

  • Type: Freelance, project-based opportunity
  • Project length: 3 weeks, with new projects launching regularly
  • Compensation: Paid per accepted task. On this project, you can earn the equivalent of up to $9 per hour, with pay rates varying by country of residence.

What You'll Do

  • Rate design samples for typography, visual hierarchy, design execution, color, layout, and overall polish
  • Follow detailed rubrics to keep your ratings consistent across high volumes of design samples
  • Identify flaws in one slide within the overall design, from minor issues like font size to major ones that require a full reconstruction of the slide
  • Edit the flawed slide using the other slides in the design as a reference, to build more cohesion across the entire design

Please note: you won’t create your own designs. You’ll rate and edit the samples we provide, following our guidelines.

What We're Looking For

Must have

  • Education in design or arts (degree or certificate)
  • 2+ years of experience as a graphic designer, illustrator, SMM specialist, or marketing professional
  • English proficiency at B2 (Upper-Intermediate) level or higher
  • Strong grasp of composition, color theory, typography, visual hierarchy, and overall design effectiveness
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain focus during repetitive tasks

Nice to have

  • Experience with Figma, Adobe Illustrator, or other modern design tools
  • Prior data annotation or AI training experience

How It Works

  1. Apply with your portfolio
  2. Register on our platform
  3. Confirm your identity
  4. Validate your skills
  5. Start earning on projects

Why Join Us

  • Work from anywhere: fully remote, with just a laptop and a stable internet connection.
  • Set your own schedule: work whenever suits you, alongside your current job, studies, or other commitments.
  • Get paid every week: weekly payouts for the work you deliver.
  • Shape the future of AI: your expertise helps train the AI tools people use every day.
  • More projects ahead: once you're validated, get access to new projects that match your skills.

location: Egypt, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, United Kingdom

raw.title: Learning Experience Designer - Math (Remote or Hybrid in Riyadh)
raw.excerpt: Role SummaryDomain: High School Math & QuantLearning Experience Designers own the learning journey for our students.
raw.description:
Role Summary

Domain: High School Math & Quant

Learning Experience Designers own the learning journey for our students. They systematically apply the best of learning science to create outstanding learning experiences for our students. This role will partner with curriculum leads, teachers, product, and engineering to create learner-centred course designs, multimedia learning assets, assessments, and facilitator guides that support measurable student outcomes.

This role is remote-first and works across time zones to align with our delivery cadence. If you are already based in Riyadh, you are equally welcome to apply and can work from our Riyadh office, full-time or part of the week, whichever suits you.

What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end learning experiences including scope & sequence, unit plans, lesson plans, assessments, and formative checks aligned to Noon learning outcomes.

  • Develop assessment strategies and rubrics that measure mastery and inform iterative improvements to content and instruction.

  • Work closely with product and engineering to translate pedagogical designs into scalable digital experiences and to QA learning flows in the platform.

  • Ensure learning resources are localised for language and other contextual factors.

  • Run rapid prototyping and user testing with students and teachers to validate design decisions and improve engagement and learning gains.

  • Train and support teachers and facilitators on new materials, pedagogical approaches, and use of EdTech tools to enable high-fidelity implementation.

  • Use data and qualitative feedback to iterate on curriculum and content, driving continuous improvement cycles.

Must-Have Requirements

  • A strong academic record. A degree in Mathematics or a quantitative field (Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics) is preferred. A degree in Education or another field works too if your mathematics is evidently strong.

  • Experience designing learning materials, or teaching, at any level. You do not need years of it. We are hiring for potential: people with the mathematics, the judgement and the curiosity to become excellent learning designers with us.

  • Passion for Math and helping students learn to love Math.

  • Familiarity with a rigorous curriculum (American, British, IB or a strong national curriculum) and with standardised mathematics assessments such as the SAT or GAT/Qudrat.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to produce clear learner-facing content and teacher-facing documentation.

  • Equally comfortable working on-site and remotely, and able to collaborate with remote teams across time zones (GMT +3 overlap preferred).

Highly Advantageous

  • Experience in delivering the American Curriculum at international schools.

  • Arabic language ability or experience working in the Middle East educational context.

  • Experience with adaptive learning systems or analytics-driven personalisation at scale.

  • Prior teaching experience in hybrid or online classrooms.

  • AI is already part of how you design. You have a strong understanding of how it works and you use it daily in your own practice.

What We're Really Looking For

  • A passionate designer who balances rigour and creativity to build learning experiences that are delightful for learners.

  • A collaborative partner who can work closely with teachers, engineers and product teams to bring ideas into production.

  • A lifelong learner who can learn new skills and consistently raise the bar.

Other details

  • Remote-first with flexibility. Occasional meetings aligned to GMT +3 are required, which is a natural fit if you are already in Riyadh. Riyadh-based candidates may work remotely, from the office, or a mix.

Why Work at Noon?

  • Solving the Biggest Problem in Education: We are tackling one of the most important and challenging issues in the sector - scaling outstanding teachers and making learning engaging.

  • Innovation at a Global Scale: Noon is a leader in edtech innovation; we are not a copycat. We pioneer new ways to deliver world-class education.

  • Strong Financial Position: We have become profitable and are well-funded.

  • International Exposure: Join a dynamic, internationally diverse team that supports personal growth.

  • Mission & Values Driven: We aim to provide equitable access to world-class education.

  • Student First: Help build the first "Open Social Learning Platform," reaching millions.

  • Be Original & Bold: A working environment where you can challenge the status quo and take full ownership of your work.

  • Never Deprive a Learner: We provide the freedom to innovate and learn from "first-time mistakes."

  • Be Better Everyday: Work closely with a leadership team committed to growth and solving global business challenges.
